ジュラの下で長きにわたって務めていたよう
である。そして彼女を支えるように、その傍
らには常に<#CTRL:0E><#CTRL:02>
text.official_en:
When Alexandra returned to her home, she
used the evidence her parents left to prove
her uncle's wrongdoings to the temples.
His confiscated assets went toward building
a shelter for those who had no place to go.
In recognition of her altruism, Jurah
bestowed on her a clan name, and her
house flourished thereafter. Alexandra
served Jurah for many years, with
<#CTRL:0E><#CTRL:02>

text.real_en: Kouka departed with <#CTRL:0E><#CTRL:02>

text.jp:
セオドラは戦後、その優れた統率力を遺憾な
く発揮し、他国に先んじてサラミスの国内を
安定させるとカイとの婚姻を発表した。冥界
戦争の英雄同士の結婚という大きな話題に国
民たちは沸き立ち、実に一か月以上にわたり
二人を祝福する祭りが催されたという。カイ
はセオドラを陰から支えつつ、いざ武力が必
要な局面となれば自ら先陣を切って戦い、勝
利だけでなく国民たちからの強い信頼を獲得
した。カイの屈託のない人柄は国民たちから
受け入れられ、セオドラと共に慕われるよう
になってゆくのだった。
text.official_en:
After the war, Theodora was a powerful
leader, stabilizing Saramis ahead of the
other nations before announcing her
engagement to Cai. The people were excited
by the prospect of a marriage between two
heroes of the Underworld War and planned
a festival lasting over a month to celebrate
the pair. Cai supported Theodora behind the
scenes and, when necessary, in battle—
ensuring not only victory but the people's
trust. Cai came to be a figure just as
beloved as Theodora.
text.real_en:
After the war, Theodora was a powerful
leader, stabilizing Saramis ahead of the
other nations before announcing her
engagement to Kai. The people were excited
by the prospect of a marriage between two
heroes of the Underworld War and planned
a festival lasting over a month to celebrate
the pair. Kai supported Theodora behind the
scenes and, when necessary, in battle—
ensuring not only victory but the people's
trust. Kai came to be a figure just as
beloved as Theodora.

text.jp:
カイは神威法王の座を継承したジュラからの
要請に応じ、ダグザ帝国の将軍として仕官す
ることとなった。いまだ各地に残る混乱を鎮
めるために奮闘するカイの傍には、伴侶とし
て彼と共に歩むレダの姿もあった。少し粗忽
な部分もある夫をしっかり者の妻がよく補い
死の運命が二人を分かつ最後の瞬間まで共に
手を取り合い、平和のために力を尽くしたと
いわれる。いつまでも若々しい姿の夫に対し
時折ふと寂しげな表情を見せる瞬間もあった
ようだが、レダは生涯幸福そうな様子であっ
たと後世に伝えられている。
text.official_en:
On orders from Jurah, who assumed the
throne of Divine Sovereign, Cai was made
a general of the Dagdan Empire. He worked
hard to quell the chaos remaining in the
land, and Leda was at his side for it all as
his wife. Her iron will helped to make up for
Cai's moments of indecision, and together
they worked for peace until death separated
them. History records that, though Leda
would sometimes look on her husband's
youthful face with sadness, she lived an
overall contented life.
text.real_en:
On orders from Jurah, who assumed the
throne of Divine Sovereign, Kai was made
a general of the Dagdan Empire. He worked
hard to quell the chaos remaining in the
land, and Leda was at his side for it all as
his wife. Her iron will helped to make up for
Kai's moments of indecision, and together
they worked for peace until death separated
them. History records that, though Leda
would sometimes look on her husband's
youthful face with sadness, she lived an
overall contented life.

text.jp:
カイはティアラに結婚を申し込む。ティアラ
は喜んでこれを受け入れ、ダグシオンに借り
た新居で二人の生活が始まるのだった。ほど
なくしてカイは帝国からの強い要請で仕官す
ることとなり、将軍として各地に残る混乱を
鎮めるために奮闘、一方のティアラも希望が
叶い神官として神殿に勤めながら豊富な蔵書
を読み漁る日々を過ごすようになる。やがて
子供にも恵まれ、カイはかつて自分が憧れて
いた平凡な家庭を手に入れるのだった。若い
夫婦のもとにはアウロラもときどきお忍びで
訪れ、賑やかに過ごしていたという。
text.official_en:
Cai proposed to Tialla and she joyfully
accepted. The two of them began their new
life in a rental home in Dagsion. Shortly
afterward, Cai entered government service
in response to the empire's dire need,
working hard as a general to quell the chaos
in each kingdom. Tialla meanwhile fulfilled
her dream of reading the wealth of books in
the temples as a priest. At long last, they
were blessed with a child, and Cai had the
normal family he longed for. Aurora would
sometimes visit, and life seemed perfect.
text.real_en:
Kai proposed to Tiara and she joyfully
accepted. The two of them began their new
life in a rental home in Dagsion. Shortly
afterward, Kai entered government service
in response to the empire's dire need,
working hard as a general to quell the chaos
in each kingdom. Tiara meanwhile fulfilled
her dream of reading the wealth of books in
the temples as a priest. At long last, they
were blessed with a child, and Kai had the
normal family he longed for. Aurora would
sometimes visit, and life seemed perfect.

text.jp:
戦後も神殿に残り、人々のために働くアウロ
ラに引き続き仕えていたウルタンドはあると
き神殿を訪れたカイと再会する。ウルタンド
のことが自分にとって家族以上の存在となっ
ていたカイは彼女に正式に結婚を申し込み、
ウルタンドもこれを快諾、二人は文字通り本
当の家族となるのだった。カイが将軍として
帝国に仕官するのと入れ替わりにウルタンド
は神殿を去ると、今度は自分たちの家庭を守
る役回りを受け持つのだった。二人の間には
四人の子供が生まれ、皆の笑顔の絶えること
のない賑やかな家になったという。
text.official_en:
Ultand continued to serve Aurora as the
goddess shifted to working on behalf of the
people. She reunited with Cai when he
visited the temple to propose to her—after
all, he already thought of her as family.
Cai became a general of the empire, while
Ultand retired from the temples to take care
of her new family. Counting the four
children they had together, their household
of six was a joyous one.
text.real_en:
Ultand continued to serve Aurora as the
goddess shifted to working on behalf of the
people. She reunited with Kai when he
visited the temple to propose to her—after
all, he already thought of her as family.
Kai became a general of the empire, while
Ultand retired from the temples to take care
of her new family. Counting the four
children they had together, their household
of six was a joyous one.

text.jp:
エスメラルダは冥界戦争の英雄という素性を
隠して小さな港町に移り住むと、漁師として
生計を立て始めた。周囲の住人とも打ち解け
新しい生活が軌道に乗った頃エスメラルダは
町に立ち寄ったカイと偶然の再会を果たす。
すっかり意気投合したカイは、エスメラルダ
のもとにそのまま居付くと一緒に暮らし始め
ることになった。エスメラルダから漁の手ほ
どきを受けたカイはみるみる腕を上げ、いつ
しか二人はリル海に住む数々の大物を仕留め
伝説の漁師として改めてダグザ中にその名を
轟かせてゆくことになるのである。
text.official_en:
Esmeralda concealed her identity as a hero
of the Underworld War and moved to a
small harbor town, making ends meet as a
fisher. After settling into her new life,
she happened to reunite with Cai when
he visited. Seeing kindred spirits in each
other, the two began to live together. Cai
learned the ropes of fishing from Esmeralda,
and before they knew it, they'd hauled up
some of the largest fish in the Lir Sea.
Their names rang out anew as legendary
fishers throughout Dagda.
text.real_en:
Esmeralda concealed her identity as a hero
of the Underworld War and moved to a
small harbor town, making ends meet as a
fisher. After settling into her new life,
she happened to reunite with Kai when
he visited. Seeing kindred spirits in each
other, the two began to live together. Kai
learned the ropes of fishing from Esmeralda,
and before they knew it, they'd hauled up
some of the largest fish in the Lir Sea.
Their names rang out anew as legendary
fishers throughout Dagda.

text.jp:
ダグザ帝国から将軍の待遇で取り立てられた
カイは、ある戦場でアレキサンドラと再会す
る。交際をはじめた二人は１年後には神殿で
婚礼の儀を執り行うこととなった。その場で
はじめてカイの母親について知らされたアレ
キサンドラは卒倒しかけるも、互いにどこか
通じるものがあったのかアウロラともすぐに
打ち解け、ブーケパラスともども家族として
迎えられることとなった。それからの長きに
わたり二人がこの地に平穏がもたらされる事
を願って共に戦い続けた様子は、ある歴史家
の残した書物の片隅に残されている。
text.official_en:
The newly minted General Cai reunited
with Alexandra on the battlefield. The two
had a whirlwind romance, resulting in a
temple wedding after only a year. It was the
first time Alexandra learned of Cai's mother,
nearly causing her to faint. But she quickly
befriended Aurora, as if they were a natural
duo, and was welcomed into the family
along with Bucephalus. One historian tells
of how the two fought side by side for years
afterward in hopes of bringing peace back
to the land.
text.real_en:
The newly minted General Kai reunited
with Alexandra on the battlefield. The two
had a whirlwind romance, resulting in a
temple wedding after only a year. It was the
first time Alexandra learned of Kai's mother,
nearly causing her to faint. But she quickly
befriended Aurora, as if they were a natural
duo, and was welcomed into the family
along with Bucephalus. One historian tells
of how the two fought side by side for years
afterward in hopes of bringing peace back
to the land.

text.jp:
ダグザ連合国構想を実現し、この地を一つに
するために奮闘するベルトラン。マクシムは
側近として彼に仕えるのみならず、王が外交
に出る際の衣装を決定したり、服や装飾品を
仕立てる王宮衣装係の大役を預かっていた。
彼が王のために生み出す数々の斬新な服飾品
は民衆の間でも大きな話題となり、模倣され
てゆくこととなる。ダグザ史を綴った後世の
歴史書の中で、ベルトラン王が常に素晴らし
い衣装を身に着けていたとされる件に関して
マクシムの存在があった為というのは識者の
論を待つまでもない事実である。
text.official_en:
Bertrand strove to realize his vision for the
Dagdan Alliance. Maxim not only served as
his aide, but also his tailor, and had final
say over what Bertrand wore to diplomatic
affairs. The many innovative outfits he
created for the king became fashionable
and widely imitated. In later histories of
Dagda, it was written that King Bertrand
was always impeccably dressed due to
Maxim's influence. All scholars of the era
agree on this point.

text.jp:
ダグザ連合国構想の実現のため日夜を問わず
積極的に働き続けるベルトラン。その傍らに
は常に彼の身を案じ、献身的に支えるゴライ
アスの姿があった。ベルトランには敵が多く
命を狙う者も現れたが、多くはゴライアスの
姿に恐れをなし、計画を見直さざるを得なか
ったという。後年、ゴライアスはある戦場で
ベルトランを逃がすために殿を務め、壮絶な
討ち死にを遂げる。ベルトランは大いに悲し
み、彼の巨躯に見合った巨大な墓を造らせ、
自分が没する際にはゴライアスと共に葬るよ
う、周囲に言い聞かせるのだった。
text.official_en:
Bertrand worked day and night to realize his
plan for the Dagdan Alliance. At his side
was Goliath, always there to support him
wholeheartedly. Though Bertrand made
many enemies, some of whom wished death
upon him, most cowered at the sight of
Goliath and reconsidered their plans. Years
later, Goliath died a hero as he covered
Bertrand's escape in a desperate battle.
Deeply saddened, Bertrand had a huge tomb
built for his large friend and told his aides to
bury him with Goliath when his time came.

text.jp:
ブレザラントの国内が落ち着きを取り戻すの
を待ち、それまで温めていたダグザ連合国構
想の実現のために動き出すベルトラン。ゲイ
ツは王の第一の側近として常にその傍に控え
生涯にわたり精力的に彼を支え続けた。また
ベルトランもゲイツのことをよく頼り、王と
臣下であると同時に親友として互いに信頼し
あうのだった。後にダグザ連合国はラーマ国
やノルマリア、サイといった東方の諸国に使
節団を送り大きな成果を得ることになるが、
そこには外交に長けたゲイツの大きな功績が
あったといわれている。
text.official_en:
Bertrand began working on his plan for the
Dagdan Alliance as he waited for peace to
return to Brezarant. Gaitz was always at his
side in this as his closest aide. The Alliance
later sent envoys to the eastern nations
of Rama, Normalia, and Sai, and these
expeditions met with great success. Many
believed that Gaitz's deft diplomatic touch
was a major factor in these endeavors.
text.real_en:
Bertrand began working on his plan for the
Dagdan Alliance as he waited for peace to
return to Brezarant. Gates was always at his
side in this as his closest aide. The Alliance
later sent envoys to the eastern nations
of Rama, Normalia, and Sai, and these
expeditions met with great success. Many
believed that Gates's deft diplomatic touch
was a major factor in these endeavors.

text.jp:
ベルトランはブレザラントの国内が落ち着き
を取り戻すのを待ち、それまで温めていたダ
グザ連合国構想の実現のために動き出す。ダ
ンテはベルトランの書記官として彼の傍らで
政の全てを詳細に記録に残してゆくだけでな
く、時に熱弁を振るい、伴侶として彼を叱咤
することもあった。それは夫だけでなく周囲
のものたちまでも大いに力づけたという。
ダンテは晩年、自らの半生を費やした戯曲
「永遠の血斧王」を発表するが、これはダグ
ザ文学史上の白眉として、遥か未来まで語り
継がれて行くことになるのだった。
text.official_en:
Bertrand began working on his plan for the
Dagdan Alliance as he waited for peace to
return to Brezarant. Dante served as his
scribe, recording all of his deeds in detail,
but never held back her passionate rhetoric
when it came to chiding her husband. Both
he and those around him found satisfaction
to know she was dedicated to holding him
accountable. Later in life, Dante published
The Eternal Bloodaxe, which she spent
half her life writing. In time, it would be
recognized as the apex of Dagdan literature.

text.jp:
終戦後、ベルトランはかねてより構想してい
たダグザ連合国構想を発表する。アラゴ王国
がいち早くこの動きに同調したことで、大陸
西部を起点とし、この地に新たな秩序をもた
らす巨大国家が芽吹くこととなる。ダグザの
地が落ち着きを取り戻し始めたころ、ベルト
ランはアスワンとの婚姻を発表し、国民たち
は数奇な運命にもてあそばれた果てに結ばれ
た二人の事を想い、心からの祝福を贈るのだ
った。そして彼らを題材にした戯曲は数多く
の作家たちによって生み出され、後世に語り
継がれることになるのである。
text.official_en:
After the war, Bertrand announced his
long-held plan for the Dagdan Alliance.
Arago was quick to sign on, forming a huge
nation in the western reaches that would
impose new order on the land. When
harmony began to return to Dagda, Bertrand
announced his marriage to Aswan. The
people turned out in droves to congratulate
the pair, whose lives seemed destined to
intermingle. It was common for authors to
write plays based on them, many of which
were hailed as classics by later generations.

text.jp:
ベルトランはダグザ連合国構想の実現のため
他国の賛同をとりつけ、自らを統一王として
その勢力を拡大していく。ベルトランこそが
ダグザ帝国の権威の正しき後継者と周囲から
目される中、ディートリヒは常に彼の近くに
身を潜めてその命を狙っていた。一方でディ
ートリヒは自分以外の者がベルトランを狙う
ことを決して許さず、そういった場面に遭遇
すると相手を余さず皆殺しにしたのだった。
かくして、最も恐るべき殺戮者は同時に最も
頼もしい守護者として、常に王の傍で共にあ
り続けることになったのである。
text.official_en:
Bertrand gained support from other nations 
to realize his plan for the Dagdan Alliance,
expanding his power as a unifying king.
While Bertrand was seen as the rightful
successor to the authority of the Dagdan
Empire, Dietrich always lurked nearby,
plotting to kill him—though he would never
allow anyone else to do so. Whenever he
uncovered an assassination scheme, he
would invariably slaughter all involved.
Thus did the world's most fearsome killer
become the king's most reliable guardian.

text.jp:
さらなる混沌を求めてダグザの地の放浪を続
けるディートリヒと、そんな彼と共に旅をす
るようになったレダ。彼女いわく「たまたま
方向が同じなだけ」とのことだが、案外気の
合う様子だったと彼らを見かけたものは証言
している。美貌の剣士と伝説級の演奏者はど
この土地でも人々の関心を集める。誰もが彼
らに見とれ、演奏に酔いしれつつも、二人に
漂う危険な雰囲気を感じ、さむざむと背筋を
震わせるのだった。二人はダグザの地を離れ
どこか遠くの地を目指したとされるが、その
後の彼らの消息は定かではない。
text.official_en:
Dietrich continued to wander Dagda in
search of chaos to combat, and Leda went
with him. She claimed they happened to be
heading in the same direction, but those
who saw them together said they got along
quite well. The beautiful swordsman and
the legendary musician attracted attention
wherever they went. They had a captivating
presence but also struck fear in the hearts
of those who saw them. The two departed
Dagda for some faraway land, and their
whereabouts thereafter remain unclear.

text.jp:
バロールが滅びても尚、混乱の続くダグザの
地でさらなる強敵を求め彷徨い続けるディー
トリヒ。修羅の如き彼の伝説は枚挙に暇がな
いが、その傍らには常に彼と共に歩んだファ
ビオの姿があったとされる。それから１００
年の時が流れ、老年の域に達していたディー
トリヒは自分を討ち取るために出撃した精鋭
二千騎の大部隊を前に、死地を悟って笑みを
浮かべていた。自分を置いてフォドラに戻る
よう告げられたファビオはこれを拒否、彼と
ともに散る道を選ぶのだった。彼ら二人に関
する記録はそこを最後に途絶えている。
text.official_en:
Even after Balor's defeat, Dietrich roamed
the land of Dagda for still more formidable
opponents. His blood-soaked exploits are too
many to enumerate, but Fabio was there for
all of them. After a hundred years, an
elderly Dietrich was met with an elite force
of two thousand knights bent on striking
him down. Seeing that death was upon him,
he smiled. Though Dietrich bade him to
return to Fódlan, Fabio stayed at his side to
meet a glorious end alongside Dietrich. The
records of them say nothing further.

text.jp:
エスメラルダは小さな港町に移り住むと、こ
れまでの戦いで得た金で小さな船を購入、得
意な漁で生計を立てはじめる。魚を売るため
に街に出た際、たまたまそこに立ち寄ってい
たディートリヒと再会、話の流れで一緒に漁
に出ることにした二人はそこで特大の怪魚に
遭遇し、苦心してこれを仕留めるのだった。
大自然との戦いに興味を持ったディートリヒ
は以後も彼女と共に漁に出るようになり、二
人の生活はその後１０年にわたり続くことと
なるが、その間にエスメラルダは二人の子供
を授かったといわれている。
text.official_en:
Esmeralda moved to a little harbor town,
purchasing a small boat with the spoils of
war, and made ends meet by fishing. Going
into town to sell fish, she happened to
reunite with a passing Dietrich. As they
talked, they decided to go fishing, and
hauled up a monster of a fish after a bitter
struggle. Dietrich's curiosity was piqued by
this battle with mighty nature, and he began
to accompany her on her fishing trips. They
stayed together for 10 years afterward, and
in that time Esmeralda bore two children.

text.jp:
大きな戦いを終えてもディートリヒの魂の渇
きは癒えず、まだ見ぬ強敵を求めてダグザの
地を彷徨い続ける。ミカエラはそんな彼を放
置できずに共に旅をするようになっており、
ひとたび戦いとなれば二人は見事な連携をみ
せるのだった。基本的に他者の意見は聞き入
れないディートリヒではあったが、記録によ
ればミカエラの言葉には比較的素直に従って
いた様子である。ミカエラが年老い、戦場か
ら退く決意をするまでの２０年間、二人は共
に旅を続け、ダグザの各地には彼らの残した
幾つもの逸話が残されている。
text.official_en:
Though the great battle was over, Dietrich's
thirst was yet unslaked, so he roamed the
land in search of new and powerful foes.
Unwilling to abandon him, Mikaela went
along, and on one occasion they exhibited
excellent harmony in combat. Dietrich was
never one to listen to others' opinions, but
the records suggest he followed Mikaela's
advice diligently. They continued traveling
for some 20 years before Mikaela grew
old and retired from combat. Many tales of
their exploits still circulate across Dagda.

text.jp:
戦争後も変わらず強敵を求めダグザの地を彷
徨うディートリヒは、戦いの中で深い傷を負
い倒れてしまう。そんな彼を救ったのは、偶
然その現場に居合わせてしまったハルヴィン
だった。恐ろしい相手と怯えつつも放置でき
ず甲斐甲斐しく彼の世話を焼くハルヴィン。
やがて傷が癒え、再び放浪の旅に出ようとす
るディートリヒは、もしも自分の中の渇きが
癒される日を迎えたときは、お前のもとに必
ず戻ると約束する。しかしハルヴィンはやっ
ぱり放置できないと、半ば強引にその旅に同
行することを決心するのだった。
text.official_en:
Even after the war, Dietrich wandered the
land of Dagda in search of strong foes,
but he collapsed after receiving a serious
injury in battle. Halvin happened to be on
the scene, and although she was frightened
of him, she couldn't leave him to die, and
dressed his wounds. Once he had healed,
Dietrich set off again, promising that if his
thirst was ever sated, he would return to
Halvin. But she was unsatisfied with letting
him go alone and insisted on accompanying
Dietrich on his travels.

text.jp:
ある時タリムーンはダグシオンで大々的に人
を集めると、その場でウーシュラとの婚礼を
発表する。豪華な宴は一週間にわたって続き
山海の珍味や異国の酒など、贅を尽くした馳
走が参加者に振舞われた。二人を知る者は驚
きつつも納得しながら、照れくさそうにする
タリムーンと幸福そうなウーシュラ、彼ら二
人の未来を祝福するのだった。夫婦になって
からも二人は変わらず仕事を続けたが、最終
的に五人もの子供たちに恵まれることとなっ
た。タリムーンは皆に厳しい教育を施しつつ
も大変に可愛がったといわれている。
text.official_en:
One day, Talimun gathered a crowd in
Dagsion to announce his marriage to Ursula.
Their wedding guests were treated to
delicacies from land and sea, as well as
exotic liquors. Though this development
surprised those close to the couple, it was
not altogether unexpected. The guests
congratulated the embarrassed Talimun and
smiling Ursula on their future together. The
two continued as coworkers despite their
marriage, and their five children knew
Talimun as both loving and strict.

text.jp:
シモンはヴァンダル商会にそのまま居付き、
タリムーンから依頼される仕事をこなす日々
を送っていた。二人の関係は友情という言葉
では表しきることの出来ない、少々複雑なも
のだった。２０年程が過ぎ、タリムーンが長
めの「休暇」をとっていた間にザラタン号が
海賊の襲撃を受ける。シモンは仲間たちを指
揮しこれをなんとか退けたものの、その際に
負った傷がもとで命を落とすことになる。休
暇を終えて戻ったタリムーンがそれを知った
時、ひどく寂しげな顔を見せたと当時の支配
人の手記に記述が残されている。
text.official_en:
Simon stayed with the Vandahl Trading
Company, spending his days going on jobs
at Talimun's request—though they weren't
precisely friends. About 20 years later, while
Talimun was off on a long "vacation," the
Zaratan was attacked by pirates. Simon led
the crew in fending them off, but perished
from wounds sustained in the attack. When
Talimun discovered this upon returning
from vacation, his manager's log noted his
immense grief.

text.jp:
タリムーンは突如ルルディヤーとの婚姻を発
表し、ヴァンダル商会はひっくり返ったよう
な騒ぎとなる。ルルディヤーはこれをよい機
会にと夫に対し父と和解することを提案しこ
れに成功、両家は大いに発展する。ルルディ
ヤーはそれからも商会のために働き、齢４５
の若さで早世することになるが、彼女が風変
りな夫との暮らしを題材にして書いた本は、
後世でも多くの人々を楽しませることになる
のだった。タリムーンは妻について語るたび
「つくづく、ほっとけない女だった」と寂し
そうに笑っていたという。
text.official_en:
Talimun abruptly announced his marriage to
Ludia, throwing the Vandahl Trading
Company into an uproar. Ludia saw the
proposal as a chance for her future husband
to reconcile with her father. She was right,
and both families prospered as a result.
Ludia continued her work for the company
and died at the young age of 45, but the
book she wrote about life with her eccentric
husband persisted after her death. Anytime
Talimun spoke of his wife, he would smile
sadly, saying, "She was too good to pass up."
text.real_en:
Talimun abruptly announced his marriage to
Lourdija, throwing the Vandahl Trading
Company into an uproar. Lourdija saw the
proposal as a chance for her future husband
to reconcile with her father. She was right,
and both families prospered as a result.
Lourdija continued her work for the company
and died at the young age of 45, but the
book she wrote about life with her eccentric
husband persisted after her death. Anytime
Talimun spoke of his wife, he would smile
sadly, saying, "She was too good to pass up."

text.jp:
タリムーンは大々的にフィアナとの婚姻を発
表する。彼女の正体は伏せられたままだった
が、商会がその直後からアラゴ王国による特
別な便宜を受けるようになった点を不審と指
摘する後年の研究者も存在する。フィアナは
それからも変わらずヴァンダル商会で働き続
け、およそ３０年後にこの世を去ることにな
る。生前は愛する夫を独占することができた
フィアナの大変に幸福そうな様子と、彼女の
死後、最愛の妻を失ってしばらくのあいだ抜
け殻のようになっていたタリムーンの様子が
様々な文書に記録されている。
text.official_en:
Talimun made a grand announcement of his
marriage to Fianna. Though they kept her
identity secret, later scholars noted the
suspiciously preferential treatment from
Arago shortly afterward. Fianna continued
to work for the Vandahl Trading Company,
passing away about 30 years later. Several
sources recorded Fianna's bliss at having her
beloved husband all to herself. They also
noted Talimun's state after her death and
wrote of how seriously his bereavement for
his beloved wife affected him.

text.jp:
「まさかダグザの地一の金持ちから求婚され
るなんてねえ」タリムーンからその申し出が
あった時、ミカエラはひどく戸惑ったが、最
終的に彼の愛を受け入れて再婚を決意、二人
は晴れて夫婦となる。ミカエラは商会所属の
戦士として若い商会員の指導にもあたり、そ
の甲斐もあってかヴァンダル商会の商隊を襲
うのは命が危ないと野盗たちから恐れられる
までになるのだった。夫婦の共同空間はミカ
エラが常に綺麗に掃除をしていたが、タリム
ーンはその点に関しては、どことなく居心地
が悪そうな様子だったという。
text.official_en:
Talimun proposed to Mikaela, saying, "I bet
you never thought you'd bag the richest man
in Dagda." Mikaela was confused by this
proposal but came to accept his brand of
love. She decided to remarry, and the two
found wedded bliss together. As a company
warrior, Mikaela trained the young recruits,
turning Vandahl's security into a force that
bandits feared going up against at the risk of
their lives. Mikaela also spent a great deal
of time ensuring their shared rooms were
clean, which Talimun found distracting.

text.jp:
戦いを終えたオルヘルはディエゴと共にクレ
ール神殿へと戻る。オルヘルの正体に関して
は、彼女自身の強い希望で伏せられることと
なった。以前と変わらない日常を取り戻した
ものの、幾多の戦いを経たディエゴの雰囲気
は以前よりも柔らかいものとなっており、神
殿内で周囲から頼られる機会も増えた。ディ
エゴは齢７７でこの世を去るまでオルヘルに
仕え、位階としてはオルヘルと同じ祭司にま
で上っていたが、彼女のことを心から崇拝し
ている様子はその生涯において最後まで変わ
ることはなかったという。
text.official_en:
After the war, Orchel returned to Credna's
temple with Diego. At Orchel's insistence,
her true identity was kept a secret. Though
life returned to normal, Diego's experiences
of war softened him, and he threw himself
into temple work. Diego served Orchel
faithfully until his death at the age of 77,
eventually rising to the rank of lead priest,
just as Orchel once was. Throughout his life,
his deep reverence for her never wavered.
text.real_en:
After the war, Orhel returned to Claire's
temple with Diego. At Orhel's insistence,
her true identity was kept a secret. Though
life returned to normal, Diego's experiences
of war softened him, and he threw himself
into temple work. Diego served Orhel
faithfully until his death at the age of 77,
eventually rising to the rank of lead priest,
just as Orhel once was. Throughout his life,
his deep reverence for her never wavered.

text.jp:
セテスはクレール神殿の一画を間借りすると
膨大な文章を書き起こす作業に没頭した。そ
れはこの地で体験した全てをセイロス教団で
待つ仲間に報告するためのものだった。
オルヘルはそんな彼のところに顔を出しては
フォドラの地の様子を聞いたり、また自分の
知る範囲で古い時代のナバテア人の話を聞か
せてくれたため、セテスの過去に対する理解
は深まるのだった。そしてフォドラに帰還を
果たした後も、セテスはあの数奇な運命に弄
ばれた悲しくも美しい女神のことを、時々思
い出すのであった。
text.official_en:
Seteth took up a corner in Credna's temple
and devoted himself to transcribing the vast
amount of texts there. His aim was to report
all he had experienced in Dagda to his
comrades waiting at the Church of Seiros.
Orchel would often visit, asking about the
state of Fódlan, and told him stories of the
ancient Nabateans from her memories.
Through these exchanges, Seteth deepened
his understanding of history. Even after
returning to Fódlan, he occasionally recalled
the beautiful yet star-crossed goddess.
text.real_en:
Seteth took up a corner in Claire's temple
and devoted himself to transcribing the vast
amount of texts there. His aim was to report
all he had experienced in Dagda to his
comrades waiting at the Church of Seiros.
Orhel would often visit, asking about the
state of Fódlan, and told him stories of the
ancient Nabateans from her memories.
Through these exchanges, Seteth deepened
his understanding of history. Even after
returning to Fódlan, he occasionally recalled
the beautiful yet star-crossed goddess.

text.jp:
オルヘルはクレール神殿の本殿に戻ると、以
前と同じ日常を取り戻した。ニネは祭司長ゲ
トメイヤに提出した希望が受理され、ダグシ
オンの分殿から本殿に異動することになり、
晴れてオルヘル付きのバルカンになるのだっ
た。オルヘルのことをまるで母親同然に慕う
ニネと、それに頑張って応えようとするオル
ヘルの姿。一介の祭司にバルカンが仕えると
いうことは本来、神殿組織の中にあって異例
中の異例な事であったが、周囲に対しそれを
ごく自然なことのように感じさせる雰囲気が
二人の間には流れていたのだった。
text.official_en:
When Orchel returned to Credna's main
temple, she resumed her former life. Ninae's
request to Archpriest Gephma was granted,
and she was transferred from the branch
temple in Dagsion, officially becoming
Orchel's attendant vulkan. Ninae adored
the priest as if she were her own mother, to
which Orchel responded as best she could.
While it was unusual for a vulkan to serve
a mere lead priest, the two had a certain
easy understanding that made the
arrangement seem natural.
text.real_en:
When Orhel returned to Claire's main
temple, she resumed her former life. Ninae's
request to Archpriest Gephma was granted,
and she was transferred from the branch
temple in Dagsion, officially becoming
Orhel's attendant vulkan. Ninae adored
the priest as if she were her own mother, to
which Orhel responded as best she could.
While it was unusual for a vulkan to serve
a mere lead priest, the two had a certain
easy understanding that made the
arrangement seem natural.

text.jp:
バロールによってもたらされた混乱により、
ダグザ帝国の威光は大きく失墜していた。そ
のような中、ベルトランはダグザ連合国構想
を発表、自らが王位につくことを宣言する。
アラゴ王国はいち早くこれに合流。各地の権
力者たちがその勢いに押され合流を始める中
ベルトランはセオドラとの婚姻を発表する。
ブレザラントとサラミスの両国は王同士の婚
姻によりその結びつきを盤石なものとするの
だった。混乱が続くダグザの地の中でベルト
ランを起点にした新しい巨大な波が、今まさ
にダグザの地を覆わんとしているのだった。
text.official_en:
With the Dagdan Empire weakened by the
chaos of Balor, Bertrand announced the
Dagdan Alliance, with himself at the head.
Arago was the first to join, followed by other
powerful allies. Queen Theodora brought
Saramis into the alliance through her
wedding with Bertrand. Though chaos still
reigned over the land of Dagda, their new
wave of harmony based on Bertrand's ideals
was poised to take its place.

text.jp:
タリムーンとセオドラは晴れて結ばれ、サラ
ミス王国とヴァンダル商会は共に過去にない
ほどの発展を遂げることになる。十数年後、
タリムーンは巨額の富とサラミスの技術を駆
使した巨大な外洋航行船ブレンダーン号を建
造すると、満を持して西の果てにあるという
大陸を目指し海都アレクトーを出港する。し
かしその途上で消息を絶ち二度と戻る事はな
かったという。彼が幻の大陸に上陸した後、
冒険の果てに王になったという荒唐無稽なも
のを含め、いくつもの伝説が詩人たちによっ
て語られようになるのだった。
text.official_en:
Theodora happily united with Talimun,
bringing unprecedented growth to both
Saramis and the Vandahl Trading Company.
A dozen years later, she lent Saraminian
expertise to building the huge, Vandahl-
funded ship Breandán. Talimun sailed it
from Alecto for the western lands but
disappeared along the way and never
returned. Poets began to tell tales of his life
on the new continent, including an absurd
yarn where he became king at the end of
one of his adventures.

text.jp:
国内の混乱が落ち着きを見せた頃、セオドラ
のもとをソロモン古王国の女王となったアナ
トリアが訪問、これを契機として祖先を共通
とする両国の国交が開始される。サラミスか
らは鉄鉱石や宝石や金などの各種鉱物が、対
してソロモンからは珍しい農作物などが持ち
込まれ、サラミス王国の発展に大いに寄与す
ることになる。数年後セオドラは男児を出産
し、ウラルトと命名される。サラミスの民が
待ち望んだ世継ぎを得て国中が大いに沸き立
つ事となるが、不思議なことに父親の名が明
かされることはなかったという。
text.official_en:
When the chaos within her kingdom began
to abate, Theodora was visited by Anatolia,
who had become queen of the ancient
kingdom of Solomon. The two nations with
a shared ancestry forged diplomatic ties.
Saramis traded minerals such as iron ore,
jewels, and gold for rare produce from
Solomon, greatly contributing to Saramis's
development. Several years later, Theodora
gave birth to a son and named him Ararat.
The people joyously greeted the heir, but the
father's name was strangely never revealed.

text.jp:
セオドラは自らの国民に対し女神ユ・ファス
の真意と、文字を禁じた法の撤廃、サラミス
国内における専門の教育機関の発足を宣言す
る。多くの者たちにとって古くからの伝統を
捨てることへの抵抗感は強かったが、セオド
ラは彼らに対し根気よく説得を続けていくの
だった。それが軌道に乗ったころ、セオドラ
とボナパルテの婚姻が発表された。国民たち
は大いに驚きつつも二人のことを祝福するの
だった。主従を超えた絆で結ばれた彼らの間
には二人の子供が誕生し、サラミスのさらな
る発展を予感させるのだった。
text.official_en:
Theodora revealed Yu Phas's true intentions
to her people and repealed the ordinance
against writing, launching a dedicated
educational institute in Saramis. Many
clung to the ancient tradition, but Theodora
persevered in persuading them. Against that
background, Theodora announced her
engagement to Bonaventure. Though the
people were surprised, they celebrated the
marriage. The pair, whose bond was beyond
queen and retainer, had two children,
heralding greater things ahead for Saramis.
text.real_en:
Theodora revealed Yu Phas's true intentions
to her people and repealed the ordinance
against writing, launching a dedicated
educational institute in Saramis. Many
clung to the ancient tradition, but Theodora
persevered in persuading them. Against that
background, Theodora announced her
engagement to Bonaparte. Though the
people were surprised, they celebrated the
marriage. The pair, whose bond was beyond
queen and retainer, had two children,
heralding greater things ahead for Saramis.

text.jp:
サラミスの国内がようやく落ち着きを取り戻
した頃、セオドラが自らの夫として指名した
相手はなんとトビヤスだった。その発表に国
中がひっくり返ったような騒ぎとなったが、
これに最も仰天したのは当のトビヤスだった
という。「いろいろ考えたが私の相手はお前
がいいという結論に達した。何度も言わせる
な、この馬鹿者」実に言いにくそうに告げら
れた言葉から本気を悟ったトビヤスは、彼女
の愛を受け入れたのだった。そして王の夫と
なってからも彼の人柄は変わらず、誰からも
愛される愉快な人物であり続けたという。
text.official_en:
When things in Saramis finally settled, it
came as a surprise when Theodora chose
Tobias for her husband. The announcement
caused a stir, but few were more astonished
than Tobias. "I have given it much thought
and concluded that you are my best match,"
she said. "Do not make me repeat myself."
But Tobias sensed her sincerity and
accepted her love. Becoming his queen's
husband changed his personality not at all,
and he remained beloved throughout the
kingdom.

text.jp:
戦後も続く混乱を収束させるために日々奮闘
するライサンダー。王への忠誠のみならず、
民衆のことを考えた行動は高く評価され、数
年後、彼は大将軍に任命されるのだった。ラ
イサンダーはたとえ言いにくい場面でも必要
とあれば適切な進言を行い、セオドラとも積
極的に意見を戦わせた。あるときセオドラは
ライサンダーに自分を伴侶にする気はないか
と問う。ライサンダーは大いに恐縮しつつも
申し出を受け、彼女を妻とするのだった。そ
の後も彼の生真面目な姿勢は変わることはな
く、厳正な立場を貫いたと言われている。
text.official_en:
Lysander worked hard to quell the tumult
that lingered after the war. He was praised
for his loyalty to his queen and his
considerate nature. After years of service,
he was appointed as a high commander.
Lysander offered sound advice even in tense
situations, and proactively debated ideas
with Theodora. One day she asked him if
he had any interest in her as a companion.
He humbly accepted the role as her
husband. But his principles never bended,
and he was strict yet fair to the last.

text.jp:
理想を目指して動き続けるベルトランが自ら
の結婚相手として発表した相手はなんとレダ
だった。彼女が王の命を常に狙う事ができる
立場につくなど周りの者たちにとっては青天
の霹靂であり、大騒動に発展するのだった。
だが、そんな周囲の危惧はよそに、レダはベ
ルトランを常によく気遣い、よく尽くしてい
たが、そのことを問われてもレダは不機嫌そ
うに言葉を濁すだけだったという。これにつ
いて後世の識者は彼女が誰よりもベルトラン
を求め続けた自分の気持ちに気付くことが出
来たからだろうと語っている。
text.official_en:
Bertrand, who continued work on realizing
his dream, announced his engagement to
none other than Leda. Putting her in a
position of easy access to the king caused an
uproar in Bertrand's court, but despite these
fears, Leda was always considerate of her
husband and did her best to support him.
When anyone questioned her intentions,
Leda grew sulky and gave vague answers.
Historians later believed this was because
she realized that Bertrand was always the
only one for her.

text.jp:
レダはシドニアでコーエンディア家を再興し
父が守ろうとしたものを自分の手で受け継ぐ
覚悟を決める。それは、愛するバッカニアの
願いを叶えてやりたいという思いからだった
のかもしれない。レダは自らの戦いで得た金
やカーラから家の再興のために用意された財
宝を投じてカッシートの復興にとりかかり、
バッカニアもそんな彼女の為に力を尽くす。
そして、街の人間たちの支持も得て、ついに
コーエンディア家は再興を果たすのだった。
バッカニアはそれ以後も、晩年までレダに対
して変わらぬ忠誠を捧げたといわれている。
text.official_en:
Leda decided to rebuild House Cohendia in
Cydonia and protect that which her father
held dear. This decision may have stemmed
from a desire to grant her beloved Buccar's
wish. Leda invested her earnings from the
war and treasure provided by Kalla toward
rebuilding both her house and Kassite, and
Buccar devoted himself to aiding her. With
the support of the people, House Cohendia
was eventually restored. For his part, Buccar
remained unwaveringly loyal to Leda until
his final moments.
text.real_en:
Leda decided to rebuild House Cohendia in
Cydonia and protect that which her father
held dear. This decision may have stemmed
from a desire to grant her beloved Buccaneer's
wish. Leda invested her earnings from the
war and treasure provided by Cara toward
rebuilding both her house and Kassite, and
Buccaneer devoted himself to aiding her. With
the support of the people, House Cohendia
was eventually restored. For his part, Buccaneer
remained unwaveringly loyal to Leda until
his final moments.

text.jp:
戦後も変わらずカーラ神殿の任務を続けるシ
ロッコだったが、ひとつ変わったことといえ
ばレダが協力するようになったことだった。
様々な場所に潜入し、数々の不正を暴き……
二人は息の合った相棒として互いの背中を預
け合う。数年後、揃ってカーラ神殿を去り、
旅の吟遊詩人として共にダグザの地を放浪す
るようになった彼らは、旅先で結局いろいろ
な事件に巻き込まれ、これらを解決していく
ことになるのだった。「これではあまり変わ
らぬではないか」と苦笑するシロッコに対し
レダは悪戯っぽく微笑むのだった。
text.official_en:
After the war, Sirocco continued to serve
Kalla as before, with one change: Leda
began working alongside him. They
infiltrated many places and uncovered
many injustices, always having each other's
backs as the perfect partners. Years later,
they left Kalla's temple to wander Dagda as
traveling bards, doing what they could
to right wrongs wherever they went. When
Sirocco dryly remarked that their lifestyle
wasn't so different from what they left
behind, Leda gave him a mischievous grin.
text.real_en:
After the war, Sirocco continued to serve
Cara as before, with one change: Leda
began working alongside him. They
infiltrated many places and uncovered
many injustices, always having each other's
backs as the perfect partners. Years later,
they left Cara's temple to wander Dagda as
traveling bards, doing what they could
to right wrongs wherever they went. When
Sirocco dryly remarked that their lifestyle
wasn't so different from what they left
behind, Leda gave him a mischievous grin.

text.jp:
様々な楽器の手ほどきを受け、その隠れた才
能を開花させていったムウは、カーラ神殿か
ら姿を消したレダを追うための旅に出る。ム
ウの奏でる演奏はやさしく、聞くものを安心
させる力を持っており、どこの酒場でも人気
を博すのだった。一年後、噂を頼りにようや
くレダに追いついたムウは、彼女に対する自
分の偽らない気持ちを打ち明ける。レダはそ
れを受け止め、ムウに詫びると伴侶として同
じ時を過ごすことを約束するのだった。かく
して二人の演奏者はダグザの地の新しい伝説
として語り継がれることになるのである。
text.official_en:
Mu, who developed a hidden talent after
learning to play a variety of instruments, set
out on a journey to find Leda, who had
vanished from Kalla's temple. Mu's gentle
music put her listeners at ease, making her
a popular performer in taverns. The trail of
rumors finally led her to Leda, and Mu
confessed her true feelings for her. Leda
apologized to Mu, reciprocated her feelings,
and promised to spend time with Mu as her
partner. Thus did the two musicians begin
a new legend in Dagda.
text.real_en:
Mu, who developed a hidden talent after
learning to play a variety of instruments, set
out on a journey to find Leda, who had

confessed her true feelings for her. Leda
apologized to Mu, reciprocated her feelings,
and promised to spend time with Mu as her
partner. Thus did the two musicians begin
a new legend in Dagda.

text.jp:
バロールとの戦いの後、レダは黒曜をカーラ
神殿に封印すると、ベルトランへの想いに区
切りをつけるべく、命を奪った者たちを弔う
旅に出る。それは極限まですり減らした自ら
の心を癒すために必要な時間でもあった。
オリンピアはそんなレダの旅に同行し、常に
一緒に行動するようになっていた。かくして
ダグザの各地には二人の薔薇が残した美しく
も賑やかな逸話の数々が残されたのである。
両者とも料理に対して極端な苦手意識があっ
たがために、食事は店で摂ることが彼女たち
の常だったようである。
text.official_en:
After the battle with Balor, Leda shut
Obsidian away in Kalla's temple and set off
on a journey to mourn those whose lives she
took while bringing closure to her emotions
regarding Bertrand. It was also a way for
her own heart to heal after it was strained
to its limits. Olympia accompanied Leda on
her quest, remaining constantly at her side.
Thus, many anecdotes of the beautiful and
spirited Roses arose all across Dagda. Since
both were extremely poor cooks, they took
all of their meals at restaurants.
text.real_en:
After the battle with Balor, Leda shut
Obsidian away in Cara's temple and set off
on a journey to mourn those whose lives she
took while bringing closure to her emotions
regarding Bertrand. It was also a way for
her own heart to heal after it was strained
to its limits. Olympia accompanied Leda on
her quest, remaining constantly at her side.
Thus, many anecdotes of the beautiful and
spirited Roses arose all across Dagda. Since
both were extremely poor cooks, they took
all of their meals at restaurants.

text.jp:
アナトリアと共にビルキスに残りティアマト
の建造に尽力するナジャ。数年後、彼は自ら
の肉体の急激な老化に苦しんでいた。肉体を
冷凍睡眠状態にしていつか新しい心核を移植
することを提案されるも、ナジャは自分の生
をありのままに全うしたいとそれを拒否し、
アナトリアはその意志を受け入れるのだっ
た。死ぬ間際、ナジャはアナトリアに心から
の感謝と自分の人生に一片の悔いもないこと
を伝え、最後まで一緒にいられないことを詫
びた。アナトリアもナジャに礼を言うと、
静かに彼のことを見送るのだった。
text.official_en:
Nezha remained in Bilqis with Anatolia,
dedicating himself to the construction of
Tiamat. Only a few years later, he began to
rapidly age. Though offered the option of
cryogenic sleep until a new Heart Core
could be transplanted, Nezha chose to live
out his life, and Anatolia respected his
choice. In his final moments, Nezha
expressed his gratitude to Anatolia and
apologized that he couldn't stay with her
longer. Anatolia thanked him too before
quietly witnessing his end.
text.real_en:
Naja remained in Bilqis with Anatolia,
dedicating himself to the construction of
Tiamat. Only a few years later, he began to
rapidly age. Though offered the option of
cryogenic sleep until a new Heart Core
could be transplanted, Naja chose to live
out his life, and Anatolia respected his
choice. In his final moments, Naja
expressed his gratitude to Anatolia and
apologized that he couldn't stay with her
longer. Anatolia thanked him too before
quietly witnessing his end.

text.jp:
ビルキスに残り、アナトリアとともに生きる
道を選んだサラン。二人は姉妹同然に互いを
想いあい、支えあった。サランはソロモン古
王国の宰相を引き受けると、アナトリアの日
常業務を手伝いつつ、交易品の管理や外交な
ど、手広い役割を担って大いに国家運営を助
けることとなる。純粋なアナトリアが見落と
しそうな部分までサランは厳しく目を光らせ
たため、封女王の脇に控える宰相は油断なら
ぬ相手だと、神秘の国ソロモン古王国を利用
して一儲けをたくらむ者たちからも一目置か
れ、恐れられる存在になるのだった。
text.official_en:
Sha Lan chose to remain in Bilqis with
Anatolia. The two were like close sisters,
with Sha Lan eventually becoming
chancellor of Solomon. She assisted with
routine affairs, as well as matters of trade,
diplomacy, and governance. Her keen
insight into what Anatolia's pure heart
sometimes overlooked earned her a
reputation as a formidable presence beside
the Forbidden Queen, especially among
those who sought to profit from exploiting
the mysterious kingdom of Solomon.
text.real_en:
Sarang chose to remain in Bilqis with
Anatolia. The two were like close sisters,
with Sarang eventually becoming
chancellor of Solomon. She assisted with
routine affairs, as well as matters of trade,
diplomacy, and governance. Her keen
insight into what Anatolia's pure heart
sometimes overlooked earned her a
reputation as a formidable presence beside
the Forbidden Queen, especially among
those who sought to profit from exploiting
the mysterious kingdom of Solomon.

text.jp:
ティアマトの完成を目指し、建造作業を指揮
するアナトリア。ダイトウは天蓋都市に残り
彼女を補佐する重要な役割を受け持つことと
なる。設計図など各種資料は残されていたも
のの、調達することが難しい素材や失われた
機材などがあまりにも多く、作業は困難を極
めていたが、この状況の中でダイトウの才能
はいかんなく発揮されることになる。ダイト
ウは最終的に７７歳で没したが、彼の存在が
あったおかげでティアマトの完成までの工期
は１００年程度短縮できたという関係者の報
告書がニカウレーの記録に残されている。
text.official_en:
Anatolia led the construction of Tiamat
toward its completion, while Dadao
stayed in the Canopy City as her assistant.
Although blueprints and documentation
remained, the scarcity of key materials and
the loss of crucial equipment made progress
challenging. But Dadao's talents were
uniquely suited for rising to this challenge.
He passed away at the age of 77, but
Nicaula's records showed that his efforts
shortened the process of Tiamat's
construction by about a hundred years.
text.real_en:
Anatolia led the construction of Tiamat
toward its completion, while Daitou
stayed in the Canopy City as her assistant.
Although blueprints and documentation
remained, the scarcity of key materials and
the loss of crucial equipment made progress
challenging. But Daitou's talents were
uniquely suited for rising to this challenge.
He passed away at the age of 77, but
Nicauley's records showed that his efforts
shortened the process of Tiamat's
construction by about a hundred years.

text.jp:
ハルヴィンはアナトリアと共にビルキスに残
る道を選び、ティアマトの建造作業という、
その後２００年にも及ぶ人類史に残る偉業を
その生涯にわたって間近で眺め続ける事にな
る。アナトリアはハルヴィンに外の世界に対
する交渉役、外交官という大役を担うことを
要請、ハルヴィンは責任の重大さに卒倒しそ
うになりつつも奮闘する。ソロモン古王国の
外交官としてのハルヴィンは人々の緊張を大
いに解きほぐし、期待された以上の成果を上
げてソロモン古王国に対して彼女なりに多大
なる貢献することになるのだった。
text.official_en:
Halvin chose to remain in Bilqis with
Anatolia. There, she witnessed the
construction of Tiamat, an achievement
that would shape the next two hundred
years of human history. Anatolia asked
Halvin to take on the important role of
envoy to the outside world. Though it was
a daunting responsibility, Halvin rose to the
challenge. As a diplomat for Solomon, she
eased tensions and exceeded expectations,
making a significant contribution as only
she could.

text.jp:
ピーテルは卓越した弓の腕前を買われ、帝国
から教官として取り立てられることになる。
ダグシオンに居を構えつつ後進の育成にあた
ることになったピーテルについて、その後特
に目覚ましい活躍などは無かったようだが当
人は「それが一番いいことだよ」と実にのん
びりとした様子であったという。一方、念願
叶って神殿に勤めるようになっていたティア
ラはいつしかそんなピーテルと共に暮らすよ
うになっていた。夫婦仲は多少の波風はあれ
ども基本的には良好で、没年も計ったように
同じ年であったという。
text.official_en:
Known for his preeminent bow skill, Peter
took up residence in Dagsion and devoted
himself to training a new generation. His
deeds never became legend, but he was
content with his life. At some point, Tialla,
who had attained her dream of serving the
temples, moved in with him. Though their
marriage had its ups and downs, the two
loved each other dearly, and passed away
within a year of each other as if destined.
text.real_en:
Known for his preeminent bow skill, Peter
took up residence in Dagsion and devoted
himself to training a new generation. His
deeds never became legend, but he was
content with his life. At some point, Tiara,
who had attained her dream of serving the
temples, moved in with him. Though their
marriage had its ups and downs, the two
loved each other dearly, and passed away
within a year of each other as if destined.

text.jp:
サラミス王国の歴史書の制作に取り組むこと
となったティアラはボナパルテの邸宅の一区
画に下宿すると、連日のように王宮に出向き
人々に口伝で伝えられていた知識を集めた。
はじめは奇異な目で見ていた者も次第に彼女
の真摯さに絆されてゆき、その様子をボナパ
ルテは実に満足げな表情で見ていたという。
ティアラは超人的な根気で収集した知識を照
らし合わせ編纂し、１０年後ついにサラミス
の歴史書が完成を迎える。そのときボナパル
テは自分の遺産のすべてをティアラに相続さ
せる意思を彼女に伝えたのだった。
text.official_en:
Tialla lived on Bonaventure's large estate to
work on the history of Saramis, visiting the
palace daily to collect knowledge that had
been passed down through the oral
tradition. Though people gave her odd looks
at first, her earnestness slowly won them
over. Bonaventure watched it all with
satisfaction. After tenaciously checking and
editing her research, Tialla completed the
history of Saramis 10 years later. That was
when Bonaventure told Tialla of his intent
to bequeath all he owned to her.
text.real_en:
Tiara lived on Bonaparte's large estate to
work on the history of Saramis, visiting the
palace daily to collect knowledge that had
been passed down through the oral
tradition. Though people gave her odd looks
at first, her earnestness slowly won them
over. Bonaparte watched it all with
satisfaction. After tenaciously checking and
editing her research, Tiara completed the
history of Saramis 10 years later. That was
when Bonaparte told Tiara of his intent
to bequeath all he owned to her.

text.jp:
神位として人々を導くために神殿に残ること
にしたアウロラ。ウルタンドは彼女を支える
ため、ダグシオンの分殿の勤めに復帰する。
あるとき市場に出向いたウルタンドは、ダグ
シオンの郊外で農業を営むようになっていた
ピーテルとばったりと再会、思い出話をきっ
かけにして二人の距離が縮まる。ウルタンド
はピーテルを自分の家族に紹介すると、交際
期間を経た後に結婚して幸福な家庭を築くの
だった。ピーテルの弱気は相変わらずだった
が、しっかり者のウルタンドに支えられなが
ら様々な困難を乗り越えていったという。
text.official_en:
With Aurora resolved to keep her position
and lead the people as a deity, Ultand
returned to the branch temple in Dagsion to
attend her. One day at market, she ran into
Peter, who had wound up as a farmer on the
outskirts of Dagsion. As they reminisced
about old times, they grew closer, until
Ultand introduced Peter to her family. After
a period of courtship, they married and built
a happy household of their own. Peter was
as timid as ever, but Ultand's force of will
saw the pair through thick and thin.

text.jp:
ピーテルはムウに結婚を申し込み、ムウは喜
んでそれを承諾した。それぞれの親にそのこ
とを報告すると、二人はリベイラ村に住居を
構え、この上なく平凡で幸福な暮らしを始め
るのだった。ムウはピーテルの農作業を手伝
いつつ、ときどき近所の野原から薬草を摘ん
できては怪しげな薬の研究を行っており、そ
の効果の実証のためにピーテルも身をもって
協力していたようである。２０年後、ムウは
それまで培った数々の薬の製法を一冊の本に
まとめ上げるに至るが、これが非常に評判に
なり、飛ぶように売れたという。
text.official_en:
Peter proposed to Mu, who gladly accepted.
After sharing the news with their parents,
they moved to Ribeira to live an ordinary
but happy life. While helping Peter on the
farm, Mu would pick medicinal herbs from
the nearby fields for her experimental
medicines, which Peter volunteered to test.
Twenty years later, Mu compiled her
findings into a book, which became a
must-have for every household in Dagda.

text.jp:
剣闘士としての日常に戻ったゴライアス。か
つての悪役は今や英雄として人気を集めてい
た。ある試合中に負った怪我がもとで一週間
にわたり生死の境をさまようゴライアスだっ
たが、そこで献身的な介護を行ったのがウル
タンドだった。たまたま観戦に来た試合で大
怪我を負った彼を無視できなかったのだとい
う。ゴライアスは感激し、かねてから抱いて
いた想いと共に、結婚を申し込むのだった。
数年後ゴライアスは闘技場の伝説の王者とな
るが、その陰で彼を支えたウルタンドの存在
が大きかったことは疑いようがない。
text.official_en:
Goliath returned to his daily life as a
gladiator. Though he still played the part of
a heel, everyone cheered him as a hero.
One day, he sustained a terrible injury,
lingering at the border of life and death for
a week. Ultand had been in the audience
and felt duty bound to care for him. Goliath
was deeply moved and proposed to Ultand,
having already harbored secret feelings for
her. Years passed and Goliath became a
legend in the arena—thanks largely to his
spouse's support from the sidelines.

text.jp:
ダンテは劇作家としての活動を再開し、多忙
な日々を送る。その傍らには、助手として彼
女を支えるマクシムの姿があった。１年後、
満を持して発表されたダンテの新作戯曲「地
獄のジェスター」の舞台ではマクシムが本人
役として主演を演じ観客を大いに沸かせるこ
とになる。それを契機にマクシムは役者とし
て新しい道を歩み始めるのだった。マクシム
は自分とジェスターのどちらが本物か悩んだ
ものの「ぼくは両方のきみを愛している」と
いうダンテの言葉に励まされ、悩みを振り払
うことができたと後に語っている。
text.official_en:
Dante resumed her tireless work as a
playwright, with Maxim supporting her as
her assistant. A year later, Dante debuted
a new play called The Infernal Clown,
starring Maxim as himself in the lead role.
This marked the start of Maxim's new life
as an actor. Though he still had doubts
whether he or Jester was the real person,
it encouraged him to hear from Dante that
she loved both sides of him equally.

text.jp:
大きな戦いを終えたハルヴィンは、マクシム
と共に大道芸をしながらダグザの地を旅する
新しい生活を始める。行く先の村々で人々の
目を楽しませつつ、いざ山賊や野盗に困らさ
れている場面に遭遇すればたちまち武力で解
決する……それは、かつてハルヴィンを守っ
て命を落とした大恩人ナッシムと、彼の率い
た曲馬団の行っていたことの追悼のようでも
あった。彼らの旅路はこの後も続き、困った
ものがあれば助けに現れる腕利きの大道芸人
の二人組として、いつしかダグザの地で語り
継がれる存在となっていくのだった。
text.official_en:
After the final battle, Halvin began her new
life traveling across Dagda with Maxim as
they put on street performances. They
entertained crowds in any village they
visited, but whenever they heard of bandits
troubling the local folk, they put a forceful
stop to the problem. Their life together was
like a tribute to Nasshim, Halvin's mentor
who lost his life protecting her, and the
circus troupe he led. Before they knew it,
they were known across Dagda as a duo of
skilled performers who helped those in need.

text.jp:
ダグシオンで剣闘士を続け大人気となったゴ
ライアス。ダンテも彼の試合の際には大闘技
場に欠かさず足を運んでいたようである。あ
る試合でゴライアスが勝利を収めた際、その
場で自分はずっと想いを寄せる相手がいるこ
と、そして今日の勝利をもってその人物に結
婚を申し込むこと、そして、それこそがダン
テであることを発表する。「こんな大観衆の
前で何を言うんだきみは！」ダンテはこれま
で見たことがないほど真っ赤になったが、し
おらしくこの申し出を受け入れ、観客たちは
二人のことを心から祝福したと言われる。
text.official_en:
Goliath became a star gladiator in Dagsion,
and Dante made a point to attend his every
match. After one rousing victory, Goliath
announced that there was someone in the
audience he'd always loved, and he wanted
to use this moment to propose to her. Dante
blushed fiercely, protesting his decision to
ask her in front of such a huge audience,
before humbly accepting the proposal. The
whole audience burst into applause.

text.jp:
少女の頃から長く勤めたクレール神殿を出る
ことにしたロレッタ。傭兵として依頼を受け
つつ混乱に苦しむ人々のためにダグザの各地
で活躍するようになるが、その傍らには常に
彼女と行動を共にするゴライアスの姿があっ
た。線の細い美女と野獣のような巨漢の組み
合わせはどこでも人目を引いた。互いに常に
騒がしく口喧嘩も絶えなかったが、ひとたび
戦いとなれば不思議と息が合い、どんな困難
な案件も次々とこなしていくのだった。やが
て二人はダグザでも有名な傭兵として揃って
名を残すことになるのである。
text.official_en:
Loretta decided to leave Credna's temple,
where she worked since she was a young
girl, and took on mercenary work around
Dagda to help quell the lingering chaos.
Goliath refused to leave her side, and the
odd duo of the slender beauty and hulking
beast attracted attention—especially since
both were outspoken and opinionated.
In battle, however, they worked in perfect
harmony, capable of handling any job, no
matter how difficult. It wasn't long before
they became famed throughout the land.
text.real_en:
Loretta decided to leave Claire's temple,
where she worked since she was a young
girl, and took on mercenary work around
Dagda to help quell the lingering chaos.
Goliath refused to leave her side, and the
odd duo of the slender beauty and hulking
beast attracted attention—especially since
both were outspoken and opinionated.
In battle, however, they worked in perfect
harmony, capable of handling any job, no
matter how difficult. It wasn't long before
they became famed throughout the land.

text.jp:
ダグシオンで剣闘士として活躍するゴライア
スのもとをオリンピアが訪問する。見識を広
め、芸を磨き、自らをさらに花開かせる手が
かりを得るために旅に出たいことを説明し、
その護衛としてぜひ同行してほしいと切り出
した彼女の依頼をゴライアスは快諾する。か
くして旅立った美女と規格外の巨漢の組み合
わせはどこでも目を引き、オリンピアが演奏
する際には常に人だかりが絶えなかったとい
う。この旅の中で二人の絆は深まり、後に結
婚することになるが、オリンピアはそれから
もさらなる活躍を続けたといわれている。
text.official_en:
Olympia visited Goliath, a gladiator in
Dagsion, to invite him as her bodyguard on
a journey to broaden her horizons and hone
her talents. He eagerly accepted, and the
sight of the giant accompanying the skilled
performer attracted even larger crowds to
Olympia's performances. As the two
traveled together, their bond grew deeper
until they wed. Olympia, of course,
continued to perform.

text.jp:
ブレザラントの国内が落ち着くのを見届けた
後、遥か東方のサイの国を目指し再び旅に出
たゲイツだったが、ダンテは取材と称して彼
に同行していた。それはゲイツ自身が見てい
た若かりし頃の夢を再び追うことであり、か
つてダンテが予言のように口にした物語の構
想そのものであった。この旅を通じて互いを
よく知ることになった二人は帰国後にすぐに
婚礼を上げており、ブレザラントの名将と稀
代の文豪という少し変わった夫婦を祝福する
ために、ダグザの地の各地から実に多くの人
間が王都ブレストンを訪れたという。
text.official_en:
After seeing to internal Brezarant affairs,
Gaitz set off to the eastern land of Sai once
more. This time Dante accompanied him,
on the pretext of doing research. Gaitz
intended to pursue the dream he had when
he was young, and the story Dante once
spun for him became a prophecy. The two
became close during their journey and wed
soon after returning home. People from all
over Dagda came to Breston to celebrate the
unusual union of a famed Brezarant general
and a rare literary talent.
text.real_en:
After seeing to internal Brezarant affairs,
Gates set off to the eastern land of Sai once
more. This time Dante accompanied him,
on the pretext of doing research. Gates
intended to pursue the dream he had when
he was young, and the story Dante once
spun for him became a prophecy. The two
became close during their journey and wed
soon after returning home. People from all
over Dagda came to Breston to celebrate the
unusual union of a famed Brezarant general
and a rare literary talent.

text.jp:
ゲイツの申し出を受け入れたウーシュラは、
ヴァンダル商会の支配人の役を辞しブレザラ
ントに移住すると、ほどなくして二人の婚礼
の儀に臨むこととなった。見た目よりも年齢
を重ねている夫婦は本人たちが思っていたよ
りも気の合う部分が多かったようで、互いの
ことを思いやり、大変に夫婦仲が円満だった
様子が、ゲイツの世話係の手記に残されてい
る。ウーシュラを妻に迎えてからのゲイツは
これまでよりも一層落ち着いた様子で、個人
の武よりも国家の内政に重きを置くようにな
る変化があったという。
text.official_en:
Ursula accepted Gaitz's proposal, resigned
from her position at Vandahl Trading, and
moved to Brezarant. The newly married
couple, both of whom appeared younger
than they were, got along better than they
expected. The journals of Gaitz's steward
indicated they were considerate of one
another and had a very happy union.
Marriage seemed to calm Gaitz, and he
began to place more importance on the
internal affairs of his country than on his
personal martial development.
text.real_en:
Ursula accepted Gates's proposal, resigned
from her position at Vandahl Trading, and
moved to Brezarant. The newly married
couple, both of whom appeared younger
than they were, got along better than they
expected. The journals of Gates's steward
indicated they were considerate of one
another and had a very happy union.
Marriage seemed to calm Gates, and he
began to place more importance on the
internal affairs of his country than on his
personal martial development.

text.jp:
ゲイツはアレキサンドラを自らの伴侶とする
ことを近しいものたちに報告する。誰しもゲ
イツの決断に驚いたものの、どこか納得した
様子で、彼と花嫁となるアレキサンドラのこ
とを大いに祝福するのだった。伯父との関係
を完全に清算したのち、ジュラの騎士の役職
を辞したアレキサンドラは晴れてゲイツの家
へ嫁ぎ、ともにブレザラント王国へ仕えるこ
ととなるのだった。婚姻後もアレキサンドラ
の武は衰えることはなく、その名声はブレザ
ラント王国でも花開き、彼女にまつわる数々
の武勇伝は後世まで残されているという。
text.official_en:
Gaitz announced to his close friends that he
was taking Alexandra as his spouse. They
were surprised by this decision but gave
him their blessings nonetheless. After
settling her relationship with her uncle,
Alexandra resigned as a knight of Jurah and
married into Gaitz's family. Together they
served Brezarant faithfully. Alexandra kept
her martial skills sharp and became famed
for generations in Brezarant for her bravery.
text.real_en:
Gates announced to his close friends that he
was taking Alexandra as his spouse. They
were surprised by this decision but gave
him their blessings nonetheless. After
settling her relationship with her uncle,
Alexandra resigned as a knight of Jurah and
married into Gates's family. Together they
served Brezarant faithfully. Alexandra kept
her martial skills sharp and became famed
for generations in Brezarant for her bravery.

text.jp:
ダグザの地の調査を再開するファビオ。それ
はもはや使命ではなく、純然たる好奇心が彼
を動かしていた。様々な場所を調べ、発見し
たものを記録に残していく。エスメラルダは
同行するうち、いつしかファビオのことを自
然に手伝うようになっており、それはまるで
師と弟子のようだったという。エスメラルダ
が年老いて動けなくなったとき、ファビオは
彼女が息を引き取るまで世話を続けた。彼女
が最後の瞬間を迎える際ファビオは実に彼ら
しくない様子で、これまでの感謝を万感の思
いとともに伝えるのだった。
text.official_en:
Fabio continued exploring the land of
Dagda, driven less by his mission than by
sheer curiosity. He always kept meticulous
records of his discoveries. Esmeralda would
accompany him, making herself useful until
the two felt like master and pupil. When
Esmeralda grew old and infirm, Fabio cared
for her until her last breath. In those final
moments, Fabio, in a departure from his
usual demeanor, expressed his gratitude in
a flood of emotion.

text.jp:
戦後も傭兵の道を進み、終わらぬ戦いに身を
投じるミカエラ。ある依頼で出向いた村で、
そこに立ち寄っていたファビオと再会する。
その体調を案じたミカエラは受けていた仕事
を終えるとそのまま彼の世話を焼き始め、
ファビオは思わず口をつく皮肉とは裏腹に、
彼女のことを受け入れたのだった。ファビオ
が調査する対象は相変わらずミカエラにとっ
ては難解だったが、文句も言わず献身的に彼
を支え続けた。ファビオはミカエラに感謝し
彼女が寿命でこの世を去るまでこの地に滞在
し続けたといわれている。
text.official_en:
Continuing the mercenary life even after the
war, Mikaela threw herself into battle after
battle. A job took her to a certain village
where she reunited with Fabio, who also
happened to be there. Mikaela worried for
his health and offered to take care of him
after her mission was over. He accepted
without a trace of his reflexive snideness.
Mikaela understood no more of Fabio's
research than ever, but she supported him
nevertheless. In gratitude, he remained in
Dagda until the end of her natural life.

text.jp:
居場所を失ったハル・ハリ族の残党たちを自
ら頭領となって導くことにしたディエゴ。そ
こにはエスメラルダも同行しており、彼女の
明るく面倒見のよい人柄は皆からもすぐに受
け入れられたのだった。無口なディエゴと明
るいエスメラルダのもとにはハル・ハリ族の
残党をはじめ森の部族たちも合流し、やがて
女神ユ・ファスを信仰する森の一大勢力へと
発展していくことになるのだが、その初代王
として采配を振るうことになったディエゴが
いささか本意ではなかった可能性については
識者の論を待たない。
text.official_en:
Diego took it upon himself to lead the
remnants of the Har Hali, who had lost
their homeland. At his side was Esmeralda,
whose cheerful kindness quickly won the
people to his leadership. Though Diego was
a man of few words, Esmeralda helped him
shape the Har Hali and the forest peoples
into a mighty force, united in reverence for
the goddess Yu Phas. Whether Diego truly
wished to rule as their first king, however,
remains a matter of debate among scholars.
text.real_en:
Diego took it upon himself to lead the
remnants of the Har-Hari, who had lost
their homeland. At his side was Esmeralda,
whose cheerful kindness quickly won the
people to his leadership. Though Diego was
a man of few words, Esmeralda helped him
shape the Har-Hari and the forest peoples
into a mighty force, united in reverence for
the goddess Yu Phas. Whether Diego truly
wished to rule as their first king, however,
remains a matter of debate among scholars.

text.jp:
ダグシオンで船を購入し、漁で生計を立てる
ことにしたエスメラルダだったが、湖の漁は
彼女にとって少し物足りないものだった。海
の側に移住することを真剣に考え始めた頃、
彼女のもとへライサンダーが訪ねてくる。
昇進が決定した彼は、真剣な様子でエスメラ
ルダに結婚を申し込むのだった。かくして
エスメラルダはサラミスの海岸沿いの街に移
住してライサンダーと共に暮らしはじめる。
しっかり者のエスメラルダはサラミスの若
い兵士たちからも人気となり、母のように慕
われる存在になっていったという。
text.official_en:
Esmeralda decided to buy a ship in Dagsion
and make a living fishing there, but found
the lake to be an unsatisfactory fishing spot.
Just when she began considering a move to
the sea, Lysander came to visit. Having
been recently promoted, he made a serious
proposal of marriage to Esmeralda. And so
it was that Esmeralda moved to a coastal
city in Saramis to start a life with Lysander.
Esmeralda's down-to-earth nature made her
popular among the young Saramis warriors,
who adored her as a mother figure.

text.jp:
ヴァンダル商会の支配人として日々の業務に
追われるウーシュラ。一方シモンは商会を離
れ、傭兵として戦いに身を投じる道に戻って
いた。数年後、商会がらみの仕事で二人が再
会したとき、シモンは柄にもなく真剣な様子
でウーシュラに伝える。「商会じゃなくて、
あんた個人に雇われてもいい。長期契約だ」
その報酬として彼が提示したのは、自分の命
がある限り、ウーシュラの一生を自分にくれ
というものだった。その実にひねくれた回り
くどい申し出を、ウーシュラは苦笑しながら
了承したといわれている。
text.official_en:
While Ursula busied herself with her duties
as manager of Vandahl Trading, Simon left
the company and returned to mercenary life.
A few years later, when the two met again 
on unrelated business, Simon was unusually
solemn with Ursula, saying, "I don't want to
work for the company, but I'd gladly accept
a long-term contract with you." In return, he
asked that Ursula spend her life with him
for as long as he should live. Understanding
full well the nature of the proposal, Ursula
accepted with a wry smile.

text.jp:
数々の死線を共にし、お互いに惹かれ合うよ
うになったシモンとルルディヤー。あるとき
シモンのことを実家に紹介したところ、ルル
ディヤーは怒り狂った父サンゴールによって
商会から連れ戻される事になってしまう。だ
が、たまたま父親が抱えていた難題をシモン
に教わった知恵で切り抜けてみせたことで評
価は一変、一目置かれることとなる。数年後
二人は晴れて夫婦となったが、それを機に
父から後継者として指名されたルルディヤー
のことを、シモンはあくまでも自分の得意分
野でこれをよく支えたといわれる。
text.official_en:
The many hair-raising events they shared
sparked a mutual attraction in Simon and
Ludia. When Ludia introduced Simon
to her family, her father, Senghor, was
enraged and took her back from Vandahl
Trading. But later, when Senghor was in a
bind, Ludia used what she learned from
Simon to overcome it, changing her father's
opinion of the man. A few years later, the
two were happily married, and Simon used
his expertise to support Ludia when she was
appointed as her father's successor.
text.real_en:
The many hair-raising events they shared
sparked a mutual attraction in Simon and
Lourdija. When Lourdija introduced Simon
to her family, her father, Senghor, was
enraged and took her back from Vandahl
Trading. But later, when Senghor was in a
bind, Lourdija used what she learned from
Simon to overcome it, changing her father's
opinion of the man. A few years later, the
two were happily married, and Simon used
his expertise to support Lourdija when she was
appointed as her father's successor.

text.jp:
様々な経験を経て互いを伴侶とすることにし
たシモンとフィアナ。常に目の届くところに
いることを強く望まれたシモンはヴァンダル
商会に腰を据える決心を固め、数年後には子
供にも恵まれた。シモンの戦闘好きは変わら
なかったが、生きることに対して以前よりも
こだわりが出てきた点と、女遊びの悪癖が
ぱったりと収まったことに関して妻の影響が
大きかったことは疑いようがない。家庭では
週に一度は辛い料理が出ていたらしく、彼ら
が借りていた部屋からは、ときどきシモンの
悲鳴が響き渡ったと伝えられている。
text.official_en:
After many shared life experiences, Simon
and Fianna decided to become partners.
Simon settled in at Vandahl Trading due to
Fianna's wish that he never leave her sight.
A few years later, they were blessed with a
child. Simon's love of fighting never waned,
but Fianna's influence led him to grow more
careful and less interested in womanizing.
Simon's loving wife served spicy food at
least once a week, and his screams could
sometimes be heard from their apartment.

text.jp:
充分な資金を用意したリリアンは悲願だった
実家を取り戻したものの、結局傭兵として戦
場に戻る道を選ぶ。シモンと再会したリリア
ンは互いに息の合った相棒として数々の戦場
を潜り抜け、１年後には自分たちの傭兵団を
旗揚げする。二人の傭兵団は目覚ましい活躍
を見せ、ダグザの地全土にその名を知られる
ようになっていくのだった。しっかりものの
リリアンはシモンから金の管理を任されると
財政面でも仲間たちを堅実に支え、やがて彼
らはダグザの地一の傭兵団と呼ばれるまでに
なっていくのである。
text.official_en:
After saving up, Lilian finally recovered her
family estate. Despite this, she chose to
return to the battlefield as a mercenary. 
She and Simon spent a year forming their
own company, which performed well
enough to become famed throughout Dagda.
Simon entrusted Lilian with managing their
money, forming a solid financial foundation
for their troops. Before long, they were
widely known as the top mercenary
company in all of Dagda.

text.jp:
相変わらずヴァンダル商会で働きながら勉強
を続けるルルディヤー。たゆまない努力が実
を結び、ついに新しく造られることになった
モルフィス支部の支配人を任されることにな
る。商会でも前例のないほどの大抜擢だった
がルルディヤーはこれを受けるにあたり、
フィアナに一緒に来てほしいと頼み込む。
フィアナはこれを快諾し、共にモルフィスに
出向していくのだった。かくして二人の才媛
を筆頭にして、新設されたばかりのヴァンダ
ル商会モルフィス支部は凄まじい売り上げを
たたき出すようになるのであった。
text.official_en:
Ludia continued her studies while working
at Vandahl Trading. Her tireless efforts
finally bore fruit when she was appointed
manager of the newly established Morfis
branch. It was a high honor within the
company, but Ludia only accepted on the
condition that Fianna accompany her.
Fianna agreed and the two of them
established themselves in Morfis. With the
two talented women at the helm, the new
Morfis branch of Vandahl Trading quickly
began to generate tremendous sales.
text.real_en:
Lourdija continued her studies while working
at Vandahl Trading. Her tireless efforts
finally bore fruit when she was appointed
manager of the newly established Morfis
branch. It was a high honor within the
company, but Lourdija only accepted on the
condition that Fianna accompany her.
Fianna agreed and the two of them
established themselves in Morfis. With the
two talented women at the helm, the new
Morfis branch of Vandahl Trading quickly
began to generate tremendous sales.

text.jp:
キジェルモの墓前に全てを報告し終えたバッ
カニアをルルディヤーが訪問する。彼女が商
会から新たに任された支部が海賊に悩まされ
ており、一緒に戦ってくれる信頼できる人間
を探す過程で、想いを寄せていたバッカニア
の元を訪ねたのだった。バッカニアはこれを
受け、商会の用心棒として期待以上の働きを
見せる。ルルディヤーは彼に感謝の意思と、
これまで秘めていた本心を伝えるのだった。
バッカニアは大いに狼狽したがルルディヤー
の真剣さに押され承諾。周囲の商会員たちも
そんな二人を心から祝福するのだった。
text.official_en:
Ludia visited Buccar after he made his
report at Guillermo's grave. Her assigned
branch at the company was plagued by
pirates, and when searching for a trusted
comrade, her feelings for Buccar led her to
choose him. Buccar accepted, performing
surprisingly well as a company bodyguard.
As Ludia expressed her gratitude to him,
she revealed her true feelings. Buccar was
initially flustered, but Ludia's earnestness
won him over. The rest of the company
showered them with their congratulations.
text.real_en:
Lourdija visited Buccaneer after he made his
report at Quijermo's grave. Her assigned
branch at the company was plagued by
pirates, and when searching for a trusted
comrade, her feelings for Buccaneer led her to
choose him. Buccaneer accepted, performing
surprisingly well as a company bodyguard.
As Lourdija expressed her gratitude to him,
she revealed her true feelings. Buccaneer was
initially flustered, but Lourdija's earnestness
won him over. The rest of the company
showered them with their congratulations.

text.jp:
戦いを終えたライサンダーはサラミス国内の
混乱が鎮まるのを待ってから、フィアナとの
婚姻を発表した。フィアナは仕事を辞め、サ
ラミスに移り住むこととなるが、これを機会
としてヴァンダル商会とサラミス王国の関係
はより深まることとなり、双方に莫大な利益
をもたらす結果に繋がったという。尚、ライ
サンダーはこの１５年程の後に伯父の後を継
いで宰相の地位に就くのだが、陰から彼を
真摯に支え続けたフィアナの影響が大きかっ
たことは、彼らを知るものにとって周知の
事実であったという。
text.official_en:
Lysander waited until the chaos in Saramis
subsided before announcing his marriage to
Fianna. She quit her job and moved to
Saramis, using the opportunity to strengthen
the relationship between Vandahl and
Saramis, with both parties reaping huge
profits. Lysander took his uncle's place as
chancellor within 15 years, but those close
to them knew that Fianna's influence from
behind the scenes was a major factor in
his success.

text.jp:
クレール神殿にて毎日真面目に神官としての
修業に打ち込むロレッタ。オルヘルのように
人々のために尽くし、皆から愛される祭司に
なれる自信はなかなか得られなかったが、せ
めてそれを目指そうと日々奮闘するロレッタ
のために、ディエゴもいろいろと助け舟を出
し、二人はより強い信頼関係で結ばれるよう
になってゆく。やがて伴侶となった二人を、
祭司長のゲトメイヤはやさしく見守るのだっ
た。時が流れ、二人ともクレール神殿の中で
並び称されるよう神官となり、人々のために
長く尽くすことになるのだった。
text.official_en:
Loretta devoted herself daily to her priestly
training at Credna's temple. Though she
struggled with her resolve to become a lead
priest loved by the people, as Orchel had
been, she remained determined. On seeing
her efforts, Diego would show support, and
the trust between them grew stronger. In
time, they became life partners, and
Archpriest Gephma watched over them.
As years passed, they both grew in esteem
as priests in Credna's temple, dedicating
their lives to serving the people.
text.real_en:
Loretta devoted herself daily to her priestly
training at Claire's temple. Though she
struggled with her resolve to become a lead
priest loved by the people, as Orhel had
been, she remained determined. On seeing
her efforts, Diego would show support, and
the trust between them grew stronger. In
time, they became life partners, and
Archpriest Gephma watched over them.
As years passed, they both grew in esteem
as priests in Claire's temple, dedicating
their lives to serving the people.

text.jp:
特に行く当てもなく引き続きクレール神殿で
勤めていたディエゴのもとを、神殿に提出し
た希望が叶って本殿への異動となったニネが
訪れる。物静かな彼女と過ごす時間はディエ
ゴにとって心地よく、その度に彼女の純粋さ
に惹かれていくのだった。近くの森で行方不
明になった人間の捜索を行ったり、人里に迷
い出てきた動物を森に返すために共に神殿を
出た際の合間など、わずかでも二人の時間が
取れた際にはディエゴは自前の笛を奏で、そ
れにニネがうっとりと耳を傾ける光景が見ら
れたといわれている。
text.official_en:
With nowhere else to go, Diego was still
serving at Credna's temple when Ninae
arrived, having been granted a request to
transfer to the main temple. Diego found
solace in her quiet presence and found
himself increasingly drawn to her purity.
Whenever Diego and Ninae had a moment
alone, perhaps while searching the nearby
forest for missing people or returning lost
animals to their habitats, Diego would play
his flute and Ninae would listen, enraptured.
text.real_en:
With nowhere else to go, Diego was still
serving at Claire's temple when Ninae
arrived, having been granted a request to
transfer to the main temple. Diego found
solace in her quiet presence and found
himself increasingly drawn to her purity.
Whenever Diego and Ninae had a moment
alone, perhaps while searching the nearby
forest for missing people or returning lost
animals to their habitats, Diego would play
his flute and Ninae would listen, enraptured.

text.jp:
戦いを終えて、ダグザの地を去ることにした
セテスは、自らの素性をロレッタに明かす。
フォドラの地のセイロス聖教会に所属してい
ること、この地に渡ってきた目的、オルヘル
やロレッタに出会えた幸運と、仲間として皆
と過ごした数年が本当に充実したものになっ
たこと。セテスはロレッタにいつかフォドラ
の地に来るよう勧めると、彼女も頷くのだっ
た。いまや二人は年齢や種族や土地を超えた
深い絆で結ばれていた。ロレッタはセテスに
時々近況を伝える手紙を出し、セテスも彼女
にまめに返事を書いていたという。
text.official_en:
After the war, Seteth decided to leave the
land of Dagda, but not before revealing his
identity to Loretta. He told her of his ties to
the Church of Seiros in Fódlan, and his
reason for coming to Dagda. He spoke of
how lucky he was to meet Orchel and
Loretta, and how fulfilled he'd felt in their
years together. Seteth encouraged Loretta
to come to Fódlan someday, to which she
nodded. Their bond transcended their age
and nationalities. Loretta wrote to Seteth
with updates, and he would regularly reply.
text.real_en:

text.jp:
この地で見聞きしたことを書き留めるため、
神殿の一角を間借りして連日、執筆作業に打
ち込むセテス。ニネはときどき顔を出しては
書き起こされた文書に目を通し、誤りの指摘
を行うのだが、ニネの記憶は極めて正確で大
いにセテスの助けとなるのだった。主だった
事柄を書き終え、フォドラの地に戻る時が来
たときセテスは、ニネに自分と共に来るつも
りがあるか尋ねる。セテスの娘をはじめ、フ
ォドラの地の精霊たちにも興味のあったニネ
はこれを喜んで受け入れ、二人は海を越え、
フォドラに旅立っていくのだった。
text.official_en:
To record all he had seen and heard in
Dagda, Seteth took a corner of the temple
and wrote each day. Ninae would stop by to
review his drafts and point out any errors.
Her remarkably accurate memory was
invaluable to Seteth, and when his history
was complete and he was ready to return to
Fódlan, he asked Ninae if she would come
with him. Curious about Seteth's daughter
and the spirits in his homeland, Ninae
gladly accepted and crossed the sea, bound
for Fódlan.

text.jp:
ボナパルテが嫁をもらったという噂が流れ、
騒然となるサラミス軍。宰相コン・ムーが真
偽を確かめるべく旧友の邸宅を訪れると、そ
こには居心地悪そうに応対するボナパルテと
若妻よろしくその世話を焼くリリアンの姿
があった。リリアンは天涯孤独のボナパルテ
のことが放っておけなくなって彼の元へ押し
かけ、そのまま居座ったのだった。目の前で
甘ったるいやり取りを見せられ、呆れつつも
帰宅したコン・ムーだったが、後日、祝言代
わりに上等の葡萄酒を旧友の家に大量に送り
付けることは忘れなかったようである。
text.official_en:
Rumors spread like wildfire among the
Saramis army that Bonaventure had found
a new wife. Seeking the truth, Chancellor
Kumos visited his old friend, where he
found an uneasy Bonaventure being well
cared for by Lilian. Unable to sit by and
watch Bonaventure wither away alone, she
had barged in and made herself at home.
On seeing their sappy domestic life for
himself, Kumos left in a daze, but he did
remember to send his old friend large
quantities of fine wine to congratulate him.
text.real_en:
Rumors spread like wildfire among the

found an uneasy Bonaparte being well

had barged in and made herself at home.
On seeing their sappy domestic life for
himself, Kon Mu left in a daze, but he did

quantities of fine wine to congratulate him.

text.jp:
国内の混乱がようやく収まりつつある頃、あ
のトビヤス将軍が妻を娶ったらしいという噂
が流れる。驚いた将校たちがトビヤスの家を
訪れ、そこで見たものはリリアンと仲睦まじ
い様子で過ごしているトビヤスの姿だった。
リリアンは軍を退役すると、二人の家庭を守
る役割を自ら買って出る。これに感激したの
かは不明だが、トビヤスは結婚を機に酒の量
をすっかり減らし、これまで以上に真面目に
働いたという。子供にも恵まれ、周囲はずい
ぶん出来た嫁をもらったものだとトビヤスの
ことを大いに羨んだといわれている。
text.official_en:
Just when the turmoil began to subside,
rumors spread that Commander Tobias had
gotten married. The surprised officers went
to his home to find him living happily with
Lilian, who had decided to retire from the
army and care for their household. Possibly
because he was so moved by this, Tobias
cut back on drinking and showed a new
solemnity they'd never seen. The two of
them had several children, and many who
knew Tobias envied him for managing to
find such a fine partner.

text.jp:
歌を教わったことをきっかけに、時々トビヤ
スと共に過ごすようになったオリンピア。あ
るときトビヤスから、申し訳なさそうに自分
とともにサラミスへ来るよう頼まれる。理由
を訊ねるとオリンピアを嫁に欲しいのだとい
う。異国の地で自分が自分らしく咲けるか悩
んだ後オリンピアはその申し出を受ける。
その結果サラミスでは、あのトビヤス将軍が
大変な美人を嫁に迎えたと国を挙げての大騒
動に発展するのだった。後年、オリンピアは
サラミスの文化において、重要な立ち位置の
人物へとなっていくのである。
text.official_en:
After learning a new song from Tobias,
Olympia began spending more time with
him. One day, Tobias sheepishly asked her
to come with him to Saramis. When asked
why, he told Olympia that he wanted to
marry her. After considering whether life
in a foreign land would allow her to truly
blossom, she ultimately accepted his offer.
The whole of Saramis was shocked to see
Commander Tobias married to such a lovely
woman. In later years, Olympia became an
important cultural figure within Saramis.

text.jp:
数々の武勲に加え、精力的な活動が認められ
たライサンダーはサラミス軍の大将軍を任命
される。自分の中での区切りがついたライサ
ンダーは、リリアンにかねてから抱いていた
想いを伝える。「思ってたより遅いし」毒づ
きつつもリリアンは彼の言葉を受け入れ、つ
いに二人は結ばれるのだった。結婚しても変
わらぬ様子の彼女ではあったが、公の場に姿
を現すときの振る舞いは、大将軍の夫人とし
てどこに出しても恥じることのない、紛れも
ない名家出身の令嬢としての堂々とした様子
だったといわれている。
text.official_en:
Lysander's diligent service and military feats
earned him a position as a high commander.
Having reached the milestone he set for
himself, he called upon Lilian to confess
his long-held feelings. Before he could even
finish, she heckled him, saying, "That took
way longer than I thought." Nevertheless,
she agreed, and the two were wed. Though
marriage didn't change her, in public she
comported herself with dignity befitting a
daughter of a noble house, in honor of her
high commander of a husband.

text.jp:
バッカニアは神殿からその経験を買われてダ
グシオンで取り立てられると、かつてのよう
に指導者として若い後進の育成を受け持つこ
とになった。オリンピアは事あるごとに彼の
もとに押しかけては、日常の愚痴や自慢話な
どを聞いてもらうのが恒例となっていた。そ
んな時バッカニアは必ず彼女のために上等な
紅茶を淹れ、お気に入りの菓子を焼いてやる
のだった。彼の傍で言いようのない安らぎを
得たオリンピアは、これからも自分の側に常
にいることを願い、バッカニアもそれを受け
入れるのだった。
text.official_en:
Buccar was recognized by the temples in
Dagsion for his experience and took on the
role of mentor for younger generations, just
as he once had. Olympia began making a
habit of visiting him whenever she could,
to have a captive audience for her boasting
and complaining. Whenever she stopped by,
Buccar always laid out fine tea and baked
goods for her. Realizing that she found
great comfort in his company, she asked if
he would remain always at her side, and
he vowed that he would.
text.real_en:
Buccaneer was recognized by the temples in

he vowed that he would.

text.jp:
女神カーラのバルカンとしてダグザの地を駆
けまわるシロッコ。神官となったムウは彼の
助手として同行するようになる。それは「あ
やつを見ておいてほしい」という、二人を似
合いと見たカーラからの密かな頼みでもあっ
た。美しく成長した相棒に、シロッコはどこ
か窮屈ながらもまんざらでもなさそうな様子
だったという。３年後、シロッコはムウに正
式に婚姻を申し込みムウもこれを快諾する。
ただし以後、たとえ仕事でも自分以外の相手
との同衾は厳禁とムウから厳しく達せられた
事に関してはむべなるかなである。
text.official_en:
As a vulkan in Kalla's temple, Sirocco was
all over Dagda. Mu, having become a priest,
went with him as his assistant—at the
request of Kalla, who secretly saw the two
of them as a good match. Though Sirocco
was a bit hesitant to have a partner who'd
grown so beautiful, he wasn't opposed to the
idea. Three years later, Sirocco officially
proposed to Mu, who accepted. However,
she strictly forbade Sirocco from sharing a
bed with anyone but herself, even for work,
showing shrewd judgment on her part.
text.real_en:
As a vulkan in Cara's temple, Sirocco was
all over Dagda. Mu, having become a priest,
went with him as his assistant—at the
request of Cara, who secretly saw the two
of them as a good match. Though Sirocco
was a bit hesitant to have a partner who'd
grown so beautiful, he wasn't opposed to the
idea. Three years later, Sirocco officially
proposed to Mu, who accepted. However,
she strictly forbade Sirocco from sharing a
bed with anyone but herself, even for work,
showing shrewd judgment on her part.

text.jp:
女神カーラのバルカンとしてダグザの地を駆
けまわるシロッコ。オリンピアはカーラの許
しを得て、彼に同行するようになっていた。
常にどたばたしているように見えるのに、
どんな困難な任務も必ず遂行し、反目しあっ
ているようで息の合った彼らは、公私ともに
最高の相棒と称されるのだった。後にオリン
ピアはカーラ神殿のバルカンとして認められ
「大輪のオリンピア」のバルカン名を授かり
「銀雹のシラクシオ」とともに残したその後
の輝かしい活躍は、ダグザの歴史を華やかに
彩るのであった。
text.official_en:
As a vulkan in Kalla's temple, Sirocco
was all over Dagda. With his goddess's
blessing, Olympia went with him. Though
the two seemed constantly at odds, they
always carried out their missions and were
known to be excellent partners both in
public and in private. Later, Olympia was
named a vulkan of Kalla's in her own right
and given the name Olympia the Cultivated.
Her achievements alongside Syracusio of
the Silver Hail were among the most
colorful in Dagda's history.
text.real_en:
As a vulkan in Cara's temple, Sirocco
was all over Dagda. With his goddess's
blessing, Olympia went with him. Though
the two seemed constantly at odds, they

known to be excellent partners both in

Her achievements alongside Syracusio of
