colorful in Dagda's history.

text.jp:
アナトリアに倣ってダグシオンで占い小屋を
開業するサラン。コンロンとの連絡役も請け
負い、キョウとともにダグザの地に散らばっ
た同胞たちを繋ぐ役割を担うことはサランに
とって誇らしくもあった。そんなある日、サ
ランは占い小屋を訪れたシロッコから自分の
妻になることを頼まれ仰天することになる。
思わず保留にしたものの、連日のシロッコの
熱意に押されついに首を縦にふるのだった。
二人の働きで神殿とジョカの末裔たちは互い
を理解し、長きにわたって構築された垣根を
取り払うきっかけを得るのである。
text.official_en:
Sha Lan followed in Anatolia's footsteps,
making a living in Dagsion as a fortune
teller. She also took on the role of liaison
with Kunlun, proud of her work with Jiang
to connect her kin scattered across Dagda.
One day, Sirocco surprised Sha Lan by
visiting her fortune-telling booth to ask that
she become his wife. She didn't answer him
initially, but his relentless enthusiasm
eventually won her over. Through their
efforts, the divide between the temples and
the descendants of Nuwa at last came down.
text.real_en:
Sarang followed in Anatolia's footsteps,
making a living in Dagsion as a fortune
teller. She also took on the role of liaison
with Kunlun, proud of her work with Kyou
to connect her kin scattered across Dagda.
One day, Sirocco surprised Sarang by
visiting her fortune-telling booth to ask that
she become his wife. She didn't answer him
initially, but his relentless enthusiasm
eventually won her over. Through their
efforts, the divide between the temples and
the descendants of Joka at last came down.

text.jp:
大きな戦いを終えてもダグザの地は混乱から
立ち直れないまま、細かないさかいは後を絶
たなかった。傭兵稼業を続けるシモンはある
戦場で見知った顔と再会する。それは、色々
な事を経た上で、結局自分にはこの道が似合
いだと傭兵稼業を再開したミカエラだった。
二人はそのまま意気投合し、共に行動しはじ
める。かつての師匠と弟子は、今では対等な
相棒として互いに背中を預けあう関係になっ
たのだった。天鼓と鉄血、二人組の傭兵が残
した痛快な逸話の数々は、後世の吟遊詩人た
ちにとって格好の題材となるのだった。
text.official_en:
Even after the great war ended, minor
disputes continued to roil the land of Dagda.
Simon's job as a hired blade led him to a
familiar face: Mikaela, who came to realize
that mercenary work was her calling. The
two hit it off and began working together,
becoming equal partners who relied on each
other. The many dramatic stories of
Sky-Drum and Redblade became fodder
for bards for ages to come.

text.jp:
ダグシオンで念願だった料理店を開くことに
したサラン。冥界戦争の英雄である上に、コ
ンロンの里に残されていた調理法を再現した
彼女の料理はたちまち大好評を得ることとな
る。ナジャはいつのまにかそんなサランの店
に転がり込み一緒に働くようになっていた。
このままでいいのと尋ねると「残り少ない余
生はおまえと一緒に居たい」とナジャは答え
サランは彼と最後まで共に歩むことを決意す
るのだった。そして、サランが生み出し、
ナジャが最も好んだ品目が、彼の死後も名物
料理として残っていくのだった。
text.official_en:
Sha Lan decided to open the restaurant she
had dreamed of in Dagsion. As a hero of the
Underworld War and a master of traditional
Kunlun recipes, she gained widespread
acclaim with her cooking. Before long,
Nezha drifted into her shop and started
working alongside her. When asked if he
was sure about this, he replied, "Whatever
lets me spend the rest of my time with you."
Sha Lan decided then and there to stay with
him. The dish she created just for him was
a staple of her menu even after his passing.
text.real_en:
Sarang decided to open the restaurant she
had dreamed of in Dagsion. As a hero of the
Underworld War and a master of traditional
Kunlun recipes, she gained widespread
acclaim with her cooking. Before long,
Naja drifted into her shop and started
working alongside her. When asked if he
was sure about this, he replied, "Whatever
lets me spend the rest of my time with you."
Sarang decided then and there to stay with
him. The dish she created just for him was
a staple of her menu even after his passing.

text.jp:
この世の命運を賭けた戦いが幕を引いても尚
ダグザの地の各地で混乱は続いていた。そん
な中、さらなる力を得るため修行の旅に出る
ナジャ。ハルヴィンは放っておくことができ
ず、危険な旅に思わず同行してしまう。初め
のうちナジャは「一人でやらねえと修行にな
らねえだろ」と事あるごとに渋っていたもの
の、ハルヴィンの必死さに折れ、次第に彼女
を頼る素直さを見せるのだった。力を合わせ
て数々の危機を乗り越えていく彼らの賑やか
な旅の様子は、ハルヴィンが途中で綴ってい
た手記の中に見ることができる。
text.official_en:
Even after the Underworld War, chaos
thrived all across Dagda. In the midst of it
all, Nezha set out on a journey of
self-improvement, accompanied by Halvin.
Nezha was unsure about her joining him,
saying he had to train alone, but he
gradually gave in and found himself relying
on her. The details of their journey, in
which they worked together to overcome
many dangers, were recorded in the journals
Halvin kept along the way.
text.real_en:
Even after the Underworld War, chaos
thrived all across Dagda. In the midst of it
all, Naja set out on a journey of
self-improvement, accompanied by Halvin.
Naja was unsure about her joining him,
saying he had to train alone, but he
gradually gave in and found himself relying
on her. The details of their journey, in
which they worked together to overcome
many dangers, were recorded in the journals
Halvin kept along the way.

text.jp:
ダグシオンで建物を借り、念願だった料理屋
を営み始めるサラン。コンロンの里に伝わっ
ていた古代の料理が大評判となったが、一定
数いる柄の悪い客たちへの対応に頭を悩ませ
なければならなくなった。サランがならず者
の客に絡まれていた時、旅の途中たまたま立
ち寄っていたダイトウに助けられ、二人は久
しぶりの再会を果たす。サランから乞われ、
そのまま店に居つくことになったダイトウは
用心棒としてだけでなく、その腕力を活かし
て力強く鍋を振るうようになるが、その後、
店はますます繁盛したといわれる。
text.official_en:
Sha Lan rented a building in Dagsion to
open her dream restaurant. Her traditional
Kunlun cuisine was very popular, but she
did worry about how to deal with unsavory
customers. Dadao happened to be passing
through as Sha Lan was harassed by a thug
and helped her fend him off, leading to a
reunion between the two. At Sha Lan's
request, Dadao stayed at the restaurant,
acting not only as security but also as head
kitchen porter. With him on staff, Sha Lan's
restaurant became even more popular.
text.real_en:
Sarang rented a building in Dagsion to
open her dream restaurant. Her traditional
Kunlun cuisine was very popular, but she
did worry about how to deal with unsavory
customers. Daitou happened to be passing
through as Sarang was harassed by a thug
and helped her fend him off, leading to a
reunion between the two. At Sarang's
request, Daitou stayed at the restaurant,
acting not only as security but also as head
kitchen porter. With him on staff, Sarang's
restaurant became even more popular.

text.jp:
ハルヴィンはダグシオンの郊外の土地を購入
し、念願だった農園を始める。試行錯誤の連
続だったが、ときどき訪ねてくるサランから
教わったコンロンの里の知識が大きな助けと
なり、ひとつずつ問題を解決していく。そし
て２年ほど経つ頃には十分売り物になる収穫
物が獲れ始めるのだった。サランはハルヴィ
ンの農園からほど近い、街道沿いの空き家を
購入し、かつて二人が語り合った夢が実現す
ることになる。ハルヴィンの野菜でつくられ
るサランの料理は大評判となり、常に人の列
が絶えないほど繁盛したとのことである。
text.official_en:
Halvin bought land on the outskirts of
Dagsion to start her farm, though it didn't
come easily to her. Sha Lan occasionally
visited to teach her techniques from Kunlun,
and gradually every problem was solved.
After two years, her produce was good
enough to sell. Sha Lan bought a vacant
house not far from Halvin's farm, and their
shared dream came true. Sha Lan's dishes
made with Halvin's produce were a hit, and
her business prospered to the point that
there was always a line of customers.
text.real_en:
Halvin bought land on the outskirts of
Dagsion to start her farm, though it didn't
come easily to her. Sarang occasionally
visited to teach her techniques from Kunlun,
and gradually every problem was solved.
After two years, her produce was good
enough to sell. Sarang bought a vacant
house not far from Halvin's farm, and their
shared dream came true. Sarang's dishes
made with Halvin's produce were a hit, and
her business prospered to the point that
there was always a line of customers.

text.jp:
ハルヴィンはこれまでの戦いで得た資金でイ
スカンダリア郡の土地を手に入れると、かつ
て夢見た自分たち家族の農園を持つ事の実現
に向かって歩み始める。想像以上に荒廃した
土地に途方にくれる彼女のもとにふらりと現
れたダイトウは協力を申し出ると、様々な農
機具をその場で生み出してハルヴィンを大い
に助けるようになる。農園が軌道に乗り始め
た頃、ハルヴィンは家族を呼び寄せることに
し、ダイトウに結婚を申し込む。ダイトウは
面食らいながらもこれを喜び、二人の新しい
暮らしが幕を開けるのだった。
text.official_en:
Using the funds she earned from battle,
Halvin bought land in Iskandariya county
and worked toward her dream of building a
family farm. But the land was more barren
than she had hoped, leaving her at a loss
until Dadao appeared and offered to help.
He crafted farming tools as needed to ease
her burdens, bringing prosperity to the farm.
Halvin decided to bring her family to join
her, and soon afterward proposed to Dadao.
Though caught off guard, Dadao happily
accepted, and they began their new lives.
text.real_en:
Using the funds she earned from battle,
Halvin bought land in Iskandariya county
and worked toward her dream of building a
family farm. But the land was more barren
than she had hoped, leaving her at a loss
until Daitou appeared and offered to help.
He crafted farming tools as needed to ease
her burdens, bringing prosperity to the farm.
Halvin decided to bring her family to join
her, and soon afterward proposed to Daitou.
Though caught off guard, Daitou happily
accepted, and they began their new lives.

text.jp:
ソレルの後を継ぎ新たなる神威法王の座につ
いたジュラはダグザ神族の代表としてブレザ
ラント王ベルトランと会見を行う。その中で
ジュラは彼の提唱するダグザ連合国構想を受
け入れ、神殿が後ろ盾となり支援を行うこと
を約束する。これ以後ダグザ神殿はその規模
を徐々に縮小していきながら、人々の信仰の
場として継続していくこととなるのだった。
text.official_en:
After succeeding Solel as the new Divine
Sovereign, Jurah met with King Bertrand
of Brezarant as a representative of the
Dagdan pantheon. She accepted the Dagdan
Alliance that he proposed, promising the
backing of the temples. The Dagdan temples
gradually diminished in influence afterward
but continued to be a place of worship for
the people.
text.real_en:
After succeeding Sorell as the new Divine
Sovereign, Jurah met with King Bertrand
of Brezarant as a representative of the
Dagdan pantheon. She accepted the Dagdan
Alliance that he proposed, promising the
backing of the temples. The Dagdan temples
gradually diminished in influence afterward
but continued to be a place of worship for
the people.

text.jp:
平和を望む声が高まる中、ジュラはソレルの
後を継ぎ、新たなる神威法王としてダグザ帝
国をまとめる立場につくことを宣言する。だ
が、神威大帝という巨大な柱を失ったダグザ
帝国の宗主国としての地位は陰り、ダグザの
地はそれぞれの地域単位で群雄割拠する長い
戦乱の時代を迎えることとなる。この地が再
び一つにまとめ上げられるまでには、そこか
ら長い時を要することとなるのである。
text.official_en:
As voices calling for peace grew louder,
Jurah announced that she would succeed
Solel as the new Divine Sovereign to unite
what remained of the Dagdan Empire. But
without the Divine Emperor to rally around,
the empire's position as a suzerain state
grew shaky. The land of Dagda entered an
era of warlords feuding over territory, and it
would be a long time before the continent
was unified under a single banner again.
text.real_en:
As voices calling for peace grew louder,
Jurah announced that she would succeed
Sorell as the new Divine Sovereign to unite
what remained of the Dagdan Empire. But
without the Divine Emperor to rally around,
the empire's position as a suzerain state
grew shaky. The land of Dagda entered an
era of warlords feuding over territory, and it
would be a long time before the continent
was unified under a single banner again.

text.jp:
バロールとの戦いを終えた後、マーズは政治
の表舞台から退くことを宣言し、中央とも距
離を置くこととなる。それは、神から人への
支配の委譲について、マーズなりに考えての
ことだったのかもしれない。以後、彼が軍神
として戦場に立つことはなかったが、新たな
る神威法王の座についたジュラのことを陰か
らよく支えたといわれている。
text.official_en:
After the battle with Balor, Mars announced
his retirement from politics and distanced
himself from the centers of power. In this
way, he helped bring about the age of rule
by humanity rather than divinity. He never
again took to the battlefield as the Bringer
of War, but he supported Jurah, the new
Divine Sovereign, from behind the scenes.

text.jp:
世界の命運を賭けた戦いの後もスミルノスは
変わることなく、己の好奇心と探求心を満た
すために日夜魔道の研究に打ち込むだけであ
った。数十年が経過した頃、新しく思いつい
た理論を用いた究極の魔道の実験中に彼自身
予想だにしなかった大爆発が起こり、スミル
ノスは彼の神殿ひとつまるごとを道連れに、
壮絶にその命を散らすこととなる。彼が最後
に取り組んでいた術は「スミルノスの禁呪」
と呼ばれ、触れ得ざる外法としてその一切を
封印されることになるのである。
text.official_en:
After the war for the fate of the world,
Smyrnos followed his nature and devoted
himself to inquiries into the nature of magic,
tirelessly researching day and night.
Decades later, an experimental spell based
on a new theory caused the spectacular
death of Smyrnos in an unanticipated
firestorm, taking his whole temple with him.
This last spell was dubbed the Forbidden
Spell of Smyrnos and remains sealed away
as voided knowledge.

text.jp:
戦いを終えたクレールは自分の神殿に戻ると
以前と同じような生活を取り戻す。日常の
雑務は神官たちに任せきりにする一方、自分
は常に愛すべき物たちに囲まれ、思いつくま
まに機械をいじる彼の姿はしかし、彼をよく
知るものから見ると、どこか寂しげな様子に
映ったといわれている。
text.official_en:
After the war, Credna returned to his
temple and resumed his life as before.
Leaving the daily chores to the priests, he
spent his time surrounded by things he
loved, tinkering with machines as he
pleased. Yet those who knew him well
noticed that he seemed somewhat lonely.
text.real_en:
After the war, Claire returned to his
temple and resumed his life as before.
Leaving the daily chores to the priests, he
spent his time surrounded by things he
loved, tinkering with machines as he
pleased. Yet those who knew him well
noticed that he seemed somewhat lonely.

text.jp:
戦いを終え、日常に戻ったクレールは、以
前よりもいっそうぼんやりとした様子で日々
を過ごしたと伝えられている。それは、まる
で生きがいを失った者のようだったという。
しばらくの後にクレールは旅に出て、祭司
長のゲトメイヤが存命なうちにその姿を再び
見せることはなかったといわれている。
text.official_en:
After the battle, Credna returned to his
daily life, growing even more absentminded
and detached than before, as if he had lost
his sense of purpose. Later, he abruptly set
off on a journey, and Archpriest Gephma
never saw him again for the rest of her days.
text.real_en:
After the battle, Claire returned to his
daily life, growing even more absentminded
and detached than before, as if he had lost
his sense of purpose. Later, he abruptly set
off on a journey, and Archpriest Gephma
never saw him again for the rest of her days.

text.jp:
戦後カーラは数年の後に神位の座を退くこと
を人々に対し宣言し、このことは大きな衝撃
としてダグザ中に伝えられた。後に神殿を出
た彼女は名を変えてダグザの地を放浪するこ
とになる。かつて自分の息子コーエンが辿っ
た道をその足でなぞるように。謎の演奏者は
ダグザの地の各地に数々の伝説を残し、あの
「乾坤の奏者」を超える存在なのではないか
と噂されるようになる。長い放浪のうちに自
分の中で確かなものを得た彼女は神殿に戻り
以前とは違った形でダグザの地の芸術の発展
に寄与するようになったと言われている。
text.official_en:
Years after the war, Kalla announced that
she would resign from her position as a god,
shocking all of Dagda. She changed her
name and wandered the land, retracing
the path her son Cohen once walked. In her
wake, she left numerous legends of a
mysterious performer whose skill surpassed
even the Virtuosa of Heaven and Earth.
Having regained her confidence during her
long wanderings, she returned to her temple
and found new ways to foster the arts
in Dagda.
text.real_en:
Years after the war, Cara announced that
she would resign from her position as a god,
shocking all of Dagda. She changed her
name and wandered the land, retracing
the path her son Cohen once walked. In her
wake, she left numerous legends of a
mysterious performer whose skill surpassed
even the Virtuosa of Heaven and Earth.
Having regained her confidence during her
long wanderings, she returned to her temple
and found new ways to foster the arts
in Dagda.

text.jp:
一時は神位としての立場を捨てたアウロラで
はあったが、自分の存在が人々にとって頼り
になるものであるならばと神殿に残ることを
決意、新しく神威法王となったジュラのこと
をよく支えたといわれている。彼女の中には
常に父である神威法王ソレルの背中が、自ら
が追うべき理想としてあったようである。
その後もときどき、ダグシオンではぼんやり
するクレールを元気に叱りとばす彼女の元気
な姿が見られたと言われる。
text.official_en:
Though Aurora had briefly abandoned her
position as a god, she resolved to remain in
her temple so long as people saw a need for
her. She provided invaluable support to
Jurah, the newly crowned Divine Sovereign.
In her heart, she still saw her father, Solel,
as a figure to emulate. When not at her
temple, Aurora was sometimes seen in
Dagsion, heatedly scolding Credna for his
absentmindedness.
text.real_en:
Though Aurora had briefly abandoned her
position as a god, she resolved to remain in
her temple so long as people saw a need for
her. She provided invaluable support to
Jurah, the newly crowned Divine Sovereign.
In her heart, she still saw her father, Sorell,
as a figure to emulate. When not at her
temple, Aurora was sometimes seen in
Dagsion, heatedly scolding Claire for his
absentmindedness.

text.jp:
自分が英雄として扱われることが肌に合わな
かったカイは、各方面からの誘いをすべて断
ると、ダグザの地を巡るために旅立っていっ
た。長い時が流れ、彼はダグザの地の覇権を
継いだ時の王のもとで大将軍として迎えられ
ていた。しかしそんなカイも、帝国暦１７２
７年に起こったフォドラのアドラステア帝国
による大侵攻の際、２万もの大軍勢を相手に
一歩も引かぬ獅子奮迅の健闘を見せ、敵兵を
恐怖の渦に叩き込むこととなったが、最後は
力尽き、討ち取られたという。
text.official_en:
Cai, who disliked the idea of being treated
as a hero, refused offers from all quarters
and set out to travel the land of Dagda.
Much later, when a single monarch had
united all of Dagda, he was welcomed as
a great general. In Imperial Calendar year
1727, during the Adrestian Empire's
invasion from Fódlan, Cai faced a force of
over 20 thousand. Yielding not a single step,
he drove into the enemy, striking fear into
their hearts. But even his strength
eventually faltered and he was struck down.
text.real_en:
Kai, who disliked the idea of being treated
as a hero, refused offers from all quarters
and set out to travel the land of Dagda.
Much later, when a single monarch had
united all of Dagda, he was welcomed as
a great general. In Imperial Calendar year
1727, during the Adrestian Empire's
invasion from Fódlan, Kai faced a force of
over 20 thousand. Yielding not a single step,
he drove into the enemy, striking fear into
their hearts. But even his strength
eventually faltered and he was struck down.

text.jp:
英雄として扱われることが肌に合わなかった
カイは、各方面から持ち掛けられた誘いをす
べて固辞すると、ダグザの地を巡るために旅
立っていった。その後カイは各地で目覚まし
い活躍を見せ続け、多くの人々を救うことと
なるのだった。結果的にカイの名は後世に残
る歴史書の中で偉大なる英雄として刻まれる
ことになるのである。
text.official_en:
Unable to accept being treated as a hero, 
Cai refused offers from all quarters and set
out to travel the land of Dagda. Throughout
his life, he continued to perform remarkable
deeds wherever he went, saving many lives.
As a result, Cai's name ironically went down
in the histories as a great hero.
text.real_en:
Unable to accept being treated as a hero, 
Kai refused offers from all quarters and set
out to travel the land of Dagda. Throughout
his life, he continued to perform remarkable
deeds wherever he went, saving many lives.
As a result, Kai's name ironically went down
in the histories as a great hero.

text.jp:
戦後ベルトランは内政に力を注ぎ、国内をあ
る程度落ち着かせると、ずっと温めていた構
想の実現のために動き出す。１年後、アラゴ
王国とも協調したうえでダグザ連合国構想を
発表、ソレルの後を引継ぎダグザ帝国を継承
した神威法王ジュラの承諾をとりつけると、
初代連合国王の座に就き、ダグザの地の混乱
の終息に向け、生涯にわたり力を尽くすこと
となる。ベルトランは連合国に反感を抱いた
諸侯たちに対しても無血による解決を第一と
し、辛抱強く交渉を行ったと言われる。
text.official_en:
After the war, Bertrand focused on domestic
affairs. Once his kingdom was sufficiently
settled, he worked on realizing his grand
idea. A year later, alongside Arago, he
announced the Dagdan Alliance. Once he
had the backing of Divine Sovereign Jurah,
who succeeded Solel as head of the Dagdan
Empire, he became the first king of the
Alliance and devoted himself to quelling the
chaos in the land. Bertrand patiently worked
to win over rulers opposed to the Alliance
plan, ensuring peace without bloodshed.
text.real_en:
After the war, Bertrand focused on domestic
affairs. Once his kingdom was sufficiently
settled, he worked on realizing his grand
idea. A year later, alongside Arago, he
announced the Dagdan Alliance. Once he
had the backing of Divine Sovereign Jurah,
who succeeded Sorell as head of the Dagdan
Empire, he became the first king of the
Alliance and devoted himself to quelling the
chaos in the land. Bertrand patiently worked
to win over rulers opposed to the Alliance
plan, ensuring peace without bloodshed.

text.jp:
帰国したベルトランは内政に力を注ぎ、国内
の混乱を鎮めると、休む間もなく己の中で長
く温めていた構想の実現に向けて走り始め
る。それはこの地の安定を実現するための新
しい枠組みを築くために必要なものだった。
長く険しい道となったが、ベルトランはどの
ようなときでも武力での解決を好まず、最後
まで辛抱強く交渉を行っていた様子が、様々
な歴史書に克明に描写されている。
text.official_en:
After the war, Bertrand focused on domestic
affairs. Once his kingdom was sufficiently
settled, he worked on realizing his grand
idea. This vision was key to a new
framework of stability for the region.
Though the road to fruition was long and
arduous, Bertrand always favored diplomacy
over military options, as vividly described
in many historical records.

text.jp:
ディートリヒはこの地を思いの外気に入り、
生涯にわたり放浪を続けることとなるが、時
の為政者たちは彼に対し非常に手を焼いたよ
うで「触れ得ざる者」として忌避された。彼
の戦いに対する渇望は生涯薄まることもなく
その最期はどこかの戦場で壮絶に命を散らし
たとされる。彼の没後しばらくしてから、ガ
ルグ＝マクに酷く破損したアンスウェラーが
届けられる。アンスウェラーは人目につかぬ
場所にそのまま封印され、いつしか「失われ
た遺産」と呼ばれるようになるのだった。
text.official_en:
Dietrich grew fond indeed of the land of
Dagda, as he wandered there throughout
his days. This proved a problem for some
of its rulers, who came to dread his
unpredictable ways. With Dietrich's craving
for battle remaining undiminished, scholars
assumed his final moments came in glorious
defeat on a battlefield somewhere. Shortly
after his death, the hideously damaged
Answerer was borne to Garreg Mach. The
blade was locked away out of public view,
and came to be known as a Lost Relic.

text.jp:
ディートリヒは思いの外この地が肌に合った
らしく、生涯フォドラに戻ることはなかった
と伝えられている。ダグザの各地を放浪する
彼に対し時の為政者たちは非常に手を焼いた
ようで「触れ得ざる者」として恐れられるよ
うになってゆくのだった。死を纏う黒い剣士
は畏怖の対象となり、世界を救済した白い救
世主と対をなす存在として人々の間で語り継
がれる存在となるのである。
text.official_en:
Dietrich proved fond indeed of the land of
Dagda, as he wandered there for the rest of
his days. This proved to be a problem for
some of its rulers, who came to dread his
unpredictable ways. The black-garbed
knight shrouded in death became a symbol
of fear, and people spoke of him through the
ages as an opposing counterpart to the
white-clad savior of the world.

text.jp:
タリムーンはある日大あくびをしながら「俺
様にしては働きすぎた」という言葉を残し、
そのまま休眠期に入ってしまう。その１０年
後、無事に目覚めたタリムーンはヴァンダル
商会に復帰すると自らの野望のために精力的
に活動を続け、財力に物を言わせてついにブ
ラン運河構想を実現、タリムーン国を建国す
る。目論見通りヴァンダル商会は世界中の富
を集中させることになるが、彼自身はさらな
る刺激を求め、王国を部下に任せると冒険の
旅に出てしまったという。
text.official_en:
One day, Talimun let out a big yawn, said,
"I've worked too hard," and fell into a period
of hibernation. Ten years later, he awoke
again and returned to the Vandahl Trading
Company. With its resources, he realized
his plan for the Bran canal and founded
the nation of Talimundia. As planned, the
Vandahl Trading Company got richer,
but Talimun himself craved excitement and
left his nation's affairs to his employees so
that he could return to a life of adventure.

text.jp:
商会で、もとの日常に戻ったタリムーンは、
以前と変わらずふらりと数年単位で消息不明
になったり、大きな商売に打ち込んだり、気
ままに冒険旅行に出る生涯を送った。最終的
に彼はダグザの地の歴史書のそこかしこに名
を残すことになるのだが、大商人としてでは
なく、どちらかというと大冒険家としての知
名度のほうが勝っていたようである。
text.official_en:
After returning to his normal routine at his
company, Talimun continued life as before:
disappearing for years at a time, devoting
himself to ambitious business ventures, and
embarking on carefree escapades. He was
remembered in the histories of Dagda—
though more as a renowned adventurer than
as a great merchant.

text.jp:
クレール神殿の本殿に戻ったオルヘルは平凡
な日常に戻ることになったが、幸せそうに過
ごす中で、彼女が時折寂しげな表情を浮かべ
ることにクレールは気づいていた。何かつ
いでがある時には復旧した神の道の門を通っ
てダグシオンを訪れ、ぼんやりとしている彼
女の姿が見られたという。２００年ほど過ぎ
たある日オルヘルは動かなくなり、もう二度
と目覚めることのない彼女の体をクレールは
神殿深くに封印するのだった。「おやすみ、
オルヘル。またいつか、そのうちに」
text.official_en:
Orchel returned to Credna's main temple
and resumed her life there. Though she was
seemingly content, Credna noticed a hint of
loneliness on her face occasionally. At every
opportunity, she would visit Dagsion via the
Gate of the Gods, where she was seen lost
in thought. About two hundred years later,
Orchel's body shut down and Credna sealed
it away deep within the temple, where it
would never move again. "Rest well,
Orchel," he said, "until we meet again."
text.real_en:
Orhel returned to Claire's main temple
and resumed her life there. Though she was
seemingly content, Claire noticed a hint of
loneliness on her face occasionally. At every
opportunity, she would visit Dagsion via the
Gate of the Divine Path, where she was seen lost
in thought. About two hundred years later,
Orhel's body shut down and Claire sealed
it away deep within the temple, where it
would never move again. "Rest well,
Orhel," he said, "until we meet again."

text.jp:
オルヘルはクレール神殿の祭司としての日常
に戻ると、以前と変わらず明るく賑やかに過
ごしたとされている。以後２００年ほどの間
は彼女のことが神殿の記録に残されている
が、それ以後については一切触れられること
がなくなってしまう。謎の多い彼女につい
て、実はダグザ神族と関わりのある存在だっ
たのではないかと推測する者もいるが、その
真相は謎のままとなるのだった。
text.official_en:
Orchel returned to Credna's main temple
and resumed her cheerful life there.
She continues to appear in temple records
for about two hundred years after the war,
beyond which point there is no mention of
her. Some theorize that the mysterious girl
had some connection to the Dagdan
pantheon, but the truth remains a mystery.
text.real_en:
Orhel returned to Claire's main temple
and resumed her cheerful life there.
She continues to appear in temple records
for about two hundred years after the war,
beyond which point there is no mention of
her. Some theorize that the mysterious girl
had some connection to the Dagdan
pantheon, but the truth remains a mystery.

text.jp:
セオドラはキュベレーの地をサラミスに併合
し、ついに積年の悲願を果たすとアム・ルー
のユ・ファス神殿の再建にも着手し、ここを
改めてダマスカルを祖とする者たちの聖地と
定める。彼女の下でサラミス王国は空前の発
展を遂げたが、セオドラは右腕を由来とする
体調の不良を理由に表舞台から退くことを決
断、自らが指名した後継者に玉座を明け渡す
のだった。その後は人前に出ることはなく、
マハマドゥの祠の辺りでひっそりと隠棲生活
を送ったと伝えられている。
text.official_en:
Theodora annexed the land of Cybele for
Saramis, and having accomplished her
people's long-held dream, began rebuilding
the temple of Yu Phas in Ahm Lu as a
holy site for the children of Damascar.
Under her rule, Saramis saw unprecedented
growth. But when Theodora's arm caused
her health to decline, she ceded the throne
to a hand-picked heir. She never again
appeared before her people and is believed
to have lived a life of seclusion near
Mahadu's shrine.
text.real_en:
Theodora annexed the land of Cybele for
Saramis, and having accomplished her
people's long-held dream, began rebuilding
the temple of Yu Phas in Ahm Lu as a
holy site for the children of Damascar.
Under her rule, Saramis saw unprecedented
growth. But when Theodora's arm caused
her health to decline, she ceded the throne
to a hand-picked heir. She never again
appeared before her people and is believed
to have lived a life of seclusion near
Mahamadou's shrine.

text.jp:
サラミス王国に帰還したセオドラは数年に及
んだ戦により荒廃した国土の復興に取り掛か
る。セオドラを慕う国民の士気は極めて高
く、サラミス王国は他国に先んじてもとの姿
を取り戻すことができたのだった。そしてセ
オドラという名は、サラミス王国の歴史の中
でも特に偉大なる王として、長きにわたり民
衆に語り継がれるものとなるのである。
text.official_en:
Theodora returned to the kingdom of
Saramis and set to work restoring the land
that had been devastated by years of war.
She was beloved by her people, and under
her leadership they restored Saramis to its
prewar state before other nations could
fully recover. Theodora's name went down
in history as one of Saramis's greatest
monarchs, and the people spoke of her
deeds for many generations.

text.jp:
レダはベルトランへの思いに区切りをつける
と黒曜をカーラ神殿に封印し、ダグザの地の
各地を旅しながら演奏をして過ごすようにな
る。各地の吟遊詩人に伝わるレダに関して触
れた歌から、ある研究家が導き出した推察に
よると、彼女はどこかに腰を落ち着けること
なく、その後４０年程にわたり放浪の生活を
続けていたようである。レダの晩年の様子に
ついては定かではないものの、幽弦の奏者と
呼ばれた彼女の伝説は、ダグザの地の各地で
長く語り継がれることになるのである。
text.official_en:
Once Leda resolved her vendetta against
Bertrand, she locked Obsidian away in
Kalla's temple and began performing across
Dagda. According to one historian's research
based on songs about her, Leda's travels
continued for around 40 years, never
settling in one place for long. Though no one
knows what became of Leda in her later
years, the legend of the Siren of the Six-
String lived on in Dagda for generations.
text.real_en:
Once Leda resolved her vendetta against
Bertrand, she locked Obsidian away in
Cara's temple and began performing across
Dagda. According to one historian's research
based on songs about her, Leda's travels
continued for around 40 years, never
settling in one place for long. Though no one
knows what became of Leda in her later
years, the legend of the Siren of the Six-
String lived on in Dagda for generations.

text.jp:
戦いを終えたレダはどこに腰を落ち着ける訳
でもなく、人々の集落を渡り歩きながらビウ
エラを演奏して過ごしたと言われている。
ある研究家によって行われた、各地の吟遊詩
人に伝わるレダに関して触れた歌からの推察
によると、彼女はその後も決して特定の土地
に根付くことはなかったようで、４０年程に
渡って放浪の生活を続けていたようである。
text.official_en:
After the war, Leda continued her travels,
playing her vihuela wherever she went
without ever settling down. According to
one historian's research based on songs
passed down by minstrels, her nomadic
lifestyle continued for another 40 years.

text.jp:
アナトリアはソロモン古王国の封女王として
奮闘しつつ、同胞たちと共にティアマトの建
造という人類の大事業を進める。その後、幾
多の困難に直面するも皆の協力を得て乗り越
えるのだった。２００年の後についにティア
マトは完成し、アナトリアは人類の宝を守る
ために同胞たちを引き連れて宇宙に上がる。
やがて彼らは「天上人」と噂されるようにな
り、いつかその時がくれば、再びこの地に再
び降臨するという伝説の存在として語り継が
れるようになるのだった。
text.official_en:
As Forbidden Queen of the ancient kingdom
of Solomon, Anatolia led her people in the
completion of Tiamat. Despite many
setbacks, she saw the project through with
the people's support. Two hundred years
later, Tiamat was ready for launch, and
Anatolia ascended into space with her
companions to safeguard humanity's
achievements. In time, they became known
as celestials, legendary figures believed to
descend again when they are needed.

text.jp:
人類の未来をかけた戦いを終えたアナトリア
は彼女の治めるソロモン古王国に去ると、歴
史上から完全にその姿を消してしまったと伝
えられている。ひとつの説では、ソロモンの
民は女王とともに天に昇り、地上を見下ろし
ているのだとも。そして約束の時を迎えた
際、彼らがこの地に再び姿を現すという天上
人の伝説が、人々の口から口へと語り継がれ
てゆくことになるのである。
text.official_en:
After ending the war for the future of
humanity, Anatolia was said to return to
the ancient kingdom of Solomon, of which
she was the ruler, before vanishing from
history completely. One theory suggests that
the people of Solomon ascended to the
heavens with their queen and watch over
this world still. The legend of these
celestials, who would one day descend
again when needed most, continued to be
passed down through the generations.

text.jp:
希望が叶い、神殿に仕えることができるよう
になったティアラ。日常業務の間を縫っては
膨大な蔵書に埋もれて過ごすという、彼女に
とって何よりも幸福な時間を過ごす傍らで、
一連の戦いを膨大な量の歴史書に記していく
のだった。その描写は正確で臨場感があり、
そこにティアラのみずみずしい感性が加えら
れた素晴らしいものに仕上がったという。
かくしてティアラ・アウグストの残した数々
の文献は後世の歴史家たちにとっての必読書
になるのである。
text.official_en:
Tialla achieved her dream of serving the
temples, spending her days alternating
between humble service and devouring the
contents of their libraries. In the course of
her contented life, she wrote a great many
histories detailing a series of battles. Her
accounts were precise, down-to-earth, and
full of Tialla's vibrant sensibilities. Thus did
the prolific writings of Tialla August
become required reading for historians of
subsequent ages.
text.real_en:
Tiara achieved her dream of serving the
temples, spending her days alternating
between humble service and devouring the
contents of their libraries. In the course of
her contented life, she wrote a great many
histories detailing a series of battles. Her
accounts were precise, down-to-earth, and
full of Tiara's vibrant sensibilities. Thus did
the prolific writings of Tiara August
become required reading for historians of
subsequent ages.

text.jp:
世界の命運を左右した戦いから生還したピー
テルは、生まれ育ったリベイラ村で平凡な日
常に戻る。幼い頃から抱き続けたティアラに
対する想いは捨てきれずにいたものの、村の
幼馴染の一人だった押しの強い女性と結ばれ
いつしか五人の子供たちにも恵まれる。時
々喧嘩などはしつつ、それなりに賑やかで
幸せな家庭を築いたという。
text.official_en:
After surviving battles that decided the fate
of the world, Peter returned to a normal life
in his hometown of Ribeira. Though he
never quite let go of his childhood affection
for Tialla, he wedded an ardent suitor who'd
been one of his childhood companions.
In short order, they were blessed with
five children, and though they quarreled
from time to time, their home was overall
a happy one.
text.real_en:
After surviving battles that decided the fate
of the world, Peter returned to a normal life
in his hometown of Ribeira. Though he
never quite let go of his childhood affection
for Tiara, he wedded an ardent suitor who'd
been one of his childhood companions.
In short order, they were blessed with
five children, and though they quarreled
from time to time, their home was overall
a happy one.

text.jp:
ウルタンドはアウロラのよき従者として、ま
たよき友人としてその人生を神殿と彼女のた
めに捧げた。誠実で面倒見のよい性格のウル
タンドは周囲からも信頼され、最終的にはア
ウロラ神殿の大祭司を務めるまでになる。そ
の立場になってからも彼女の真摯な姿勢は変
わることはなく、どのような者の話も親身に
なって耳を傾け、優しく救いの手を差し伸べ
たといわれている。
text.official_en:
As Aurora's attendant and friend, Ultand
devoted her life to the temple and to her
goddess. Ultand's loyal and attentive nature
made her one of the temple's most reliable
priests, and she ultimately came to serve as
high priest of Aurora's temple. Even after
her elevation to the role, she remained
earnest and kind, lending an ear and a hand
to whoever needed one.

text.jp:
マクシムは祖国であるアラゴ王国に戻り家族
と再会すると、自分の特技を活かして王都グ
ラン・アラゴンで仕立て屋を開業する。彼の
手によって生み出される斬新な意匠を施され
た服の数々は男女を問わず人々を魅了し、夢
中にさせたという。マクシムの店はアラゴ王
国のなかでもとりわけ高い評価を得て、訪れ
る客が絶えることがなかった様子が後世に伝
えられている。
text.official_en:
Maxim returned to his homeland of Arago
to reunite with his family. He used his
unique skills to open a tailor's shop in the
capital of Grand Aragon, where he produced
innovative clothing that turned heads of
all genders. The shop soon became one of
Arago's trendiest establishments.

text.jp:
故郷に戻ったゴライアスは冥界戦争の英雄と
して皆から迎えられる。幾多の戦いを経て人
間的に大きな成長を遂げたゴライアスは、か
つて自分を排斥し、いがみ合った者たちとも
和解を果たし、周囲から乞われてケトール族
の長となるのだった。ゴライアスはベルトラ
ンたちとの交流によって身につけた知見を活
かしてケトール族を率い、空前の発展に導い
たという。
text.official_en:
Goliath returned to his hometown, where he
was hailed as a hero of the Underworld
War. Having grown as a person through
countless battles, Goliath made peace with 
those who cast him out and was asked by
his people to become the leader of the
Chetaur. He led them into a period of 
unprecedented prosperity using all that he'd
learned from Bertrand and his friends.

text.jp:
ゲイツはベルトランに心からの忠誠を捧げ、
長きにわたり仕えたといわれる。ベルトラン
もゲイツのことは忠実な部下以上に、親友と
してよく頼っていたようである。困難な状況
にあるときは必ずゲイツに意見を求め、彼も
また、これに適切に応えたという。後世の歴
史家は言う。ベルトランの目覚ましい活躍は
ゲイツ将軍の忠義と献身あればこそと。
text.official_en:
Gaitz was wholeheartedly loyal to Bertrand
and served him for many years. The king
relied on Gaitz not just as a retainer, but
as a close friend and counselor in difficult
situations. Historians believe that Bertrand's
remarkable achievements were due largely
to General Gaitz's loyalty and dedication.
text.real_en:
Gates was wholeheartedly loyal to Bertrand
and served him for many years. The king
relied on Gates not just as a retainer, but
as a close friend and counselor in difficult
situations. Historians believe that Bertrand's
remarkable achievements were due largely
to General Gates's loyalty and dedication.

text.jp:
ゲイツ自身もブレザラント王家の血統を継ぐ
身ではあったものの、決して出しゃばること
はなく、ベルトラン亡き後に選出された王に
対し仕え、よく支えていたという。
それから３１年ほどが経った後、時のブレザ
ラント王に頼んで暇をもらったゲイツは若き
頃と同じように武者修行の旅に出るが、そこ
で彼の消息は途絶えたと言われている。
text.official_en:
Though Gaitz was a descendant of the
Brezarant royal family, he never sought to
lead, and instead served the king elected
after Bertrand's death. Thirty-one years
later, Gaitz requested a leave of absence and
set off on a journey of knight errantry, just
as he had done in his youth. No one in
Dagda heard from him again.
text.real_en:
Though Gates was a descendant of the
Brezarant royal family, he never sought to
lead, and instead served the king elected
after Bertrand's death. Thirty-one years
later, Gates requested a leave of absence and
set off on a journey of knight errantry, just
as he had done in his youth. No one in
Dagda heard from him again.

text.jp:
戦後ダンテは自らの邸宅に閉じこもると、戦
いの中で経験したことをもとに、同時並行で
複数の作品の執筆にとりかかる。それは鬼気
迫る様子で、何かに取り憑かれているかのよ
うだったというが、そこで生み出された作品
はいずれも時代を超えて語り継がれる傑作と
なる。生前のダンテの元には弟子入りを乞う
者が後を絶たずに訪れたが、彼女のあまりの
奔放さに、たった一名を除いてついていくこ
とが出来なかったという。
text.official_en:
After the war, Dante holed up in her estate
and began writing several works at once,
drawing on her experiences of the war.
She wrote as if possessed, and each work
she penned during this period was a
masterpiece passed down for generations.
All her life, a constant stream of journeyman
writers begged to be her apprentice, but she
was so manic in her creativity that only one
could ever keep up with her.

text.jp:
ファビオはヴリトラに対し、一連の状況の詳
細な報告および、ダグザの地に関して収集し
た数々の情報を引き渡したのを最後に消息を
絶ち、彼の組織であるアガルタにも帰還しな
かったようである。なんらかの事故に巻き込
まれたのか、本人の意思か……判断するにも
材料が乏しく真相は誰にもわからなかった。
結局、彼がフォドラの地に戻ったかどうかも
わからぬままにアガルタからファビオの正式
な名は抹消され、捜索の手が出されることも
なかったという。
text.official_en:
After a series of status reports containing a
wealth of data on the lands of Dagda,
communication from Fabio to Vritra ceased.
It seems that he never returned to Agartha.
Whether this was his own will or the result
of circumstances beyond his control is
unknown. Whether or not he ever returned
to Fódlan, it is known that Fabio's formal
name was erased from Agarthan records.
No search for him was undertaken.

text.jp:
故郷の母親のもとに戻り、凄腕の漁師として
暮らすようになるエスメラルダ。彼女の振る
う槍は、どのような海の魔獣をも仕留め、伝
説の漁師として語り継がれる存在となる。
その後、地元の幼馴染と結ばれ、五人の子供
に恵まれたという。彼女は賑やかな日々を送
りながら、その子達に自分の祖先の話を聞か
せるのだった。海の向こう側にある、まだ見
ぬフォドラの地に想いをはせながら。
text.official_en:
Esmeralda returned to her mother in her
hometown and began her life as a master
fisher. With spear in hand, she took down
any and all sea beasts threatening her home,
going down in history as a legendary angler.
At some point, she married a friend from
her childhood, and the two were blessed
with five children. Esmeralda would regale
them with tales of her vivacious life and
her proud ancestor, painting them a picture
of the land of Fódlan beyond the sea.

text.jp:
戦後ウーシュラはヴァンダル商会の支配人と
して引き続きその卓越した手腕を振るった。
美しい彼女に下心を持って近づく者は少なく
なかったが、相手が誰であろうと一切なびく
様子を見せなかったという。ウーシュラはそ
の後５０年ほどで商会を去ると、人目につか
ぬ場所でひっそりと隠棲生活に入ったとされ
る。尚、裏付けのない説ではあるが、彼女は
密かに海を渡り生まれ故郷の地に戻ったとも
言われている。
text.official_en:
Ursula continued to prosper as manager of
the Vandahl Trading Company. Though
many attempted to court her, she chose to
remain steadfast in her work, rather than
pursue any semblance of romance. After 50
more years of service, Ursula retired to a
remote location where she lived out the rest
of her days in peace. It is said, however,
that she would often cross the sea in secret
to visit her motherland of Fódlan, although
this theory has yet to be proven and remains
merely rumor.

text.jp:
バロールとの戦いが終わった後も、シモンは
傭兵として血なまぐさい戦場ばかりを選んで
渡り歩くようになる。いつしか「戦いのある
ところ天鼓のシモンあり」と囁かれるように
なっていたが、もはや並の戦場では彼を満た
すことは出来ず、いつも物足りなさそうな顔
をしていたと伝えられる。後にシモンはある
戦場に向かう街道で蛇に噛まれ、そのまま息
を引き取ることになるが「まさか戦場以外で
命を落とすことになるとはね」という自嘲気
味な独白が、彼の最期の言葉となった。
text.official_en:
Even after the battle with Balor, Simon
worked as a mercenary, choosing only the
most violent of conflicts. It was whispered
that "wherever war rages, there you'll find
the Sky-Drum." But no battlefield could truly
fulfill him, and he never found satisfaction
in combat. One day while traveling to the
next war, Simon was bitten by a snake and
died on the road. His final words were a
grim joke at his own expense: "Who knew
I'd die anywhere but in battle?"

text.jp:
ルルディヤーはその後もヴァンダル商会に身
を置き続け、日々、模範的とまでいわれるほ
ど真面目に業務にあたっていた。彼女の非凡
な才覚と目利きの良さは商会内でも高く評価
され、新設されることとなったヴァンダル商
会サラミス支部の支配人という立場に大抜擢
されることになる。そのようになってからも
ルルディヤーと父親との関係は相変わらず
いたって良好だったという。
text.official_en:
Ludia continued her work at Vandahl
Trading, working diligently each day. Her
extraordinary talent and keen eye earned
her high praise within the company, and she
was soon promoted to manager of their
newly established Saramis branch. Through
it all, Ludia's relationship with her father
remained as strong as ever.
text.real_en:
Lourdija continued her work at Vandahl
Trading, working diligently each day. Her
extraordinary talent and keen eye earned
her high praise within the company, and she
was soon promoted to manager of their
newly established Saramis branch. Through
it all, Lourdija's relationship with her father
remained as strong as ever.

text.jp:
フィアナは仲間たちの元を去ると、自分の力
を人々のために役立てるべくダグシオンで神
殿に仕えるようになり、肉体に傷を負った者
達の治療を率先して行うのだった。常に心優
しく真摯なフィアナはいつしか聖女に例えら
れるようになり、彼女の元には悩みを聞いて
もらうために多くの者たちが訪れ、その列が
なかなか途切れなかったという逸話が残され
ている。
text.official_en:
After parting with her companions, Fianna
began to serve the temples in Dagsion, using
her powers to help the people and heal the
injured. Always kind and sincere, Fianna
came to be likened to a saint, and there are
many stories of people coming to her to
have their troubles heard. The line of those
in need never seemed to end.

text.jp:
ファティマとして過ごしたかつての記憶を完
全に取り戻したフィアナはアラゴ王国に戻り
以後の人生を祖国の復興のために尽くした。
ひたむきな彼女の姿は、亡き兄の罪を償お
うとしているようで、心を打たれた者も多か
ったようである。フィアナは１１年後にアラ
ゴ王国内で起こった内乱の際に、兄ギルキル
スに対して深い恨みを抱く者の凶刃に倒れる
が、その時の彼女はすでに覚悟が決まってい
たかのように、毅然とした様子だったと後世
に伝えられている。
text.official_en:
Having regained her memories of her time
as Fatima, Fianna returned to Arago and
spent the rest of her life working toward the
restoration of her homeland. She toiled with
single-minded purpose, as if trying to atone
for her brother's sins, and the people were
touched by her dedication. Eleven years
later, a civil war broke out. In the chaos,
Fianna was felled by someone holding a
grudge against her brother, Gilchris, despite
her own resentment toward him. Yet she
met her end stoically, as if long ready for it.

text.jp:
ディエゴは神官としてクレール神殿に務めな
がら、ダグザの地に暮らす人々が胸の内に抱
く女神ユ・ファスやダマスカルの末裔たちに
対する偏見を取り除くための活動に力を尽く
した。いつも不愛想なのは最後まで変わらな
かったが、彼の周囲にはその真摯な姿勢に共
感する者たちがよく集まっていたという。
text.official_en:
While serving as a priest at Credna's temple,
Diego worked to dispel prejudice against the
goddess Yu Phas and the children of
Damascar. Though he remained aloof to the
end, many who were struck by his sincerity
found themselves drawn to his cause.
text.real_en:
While serving as a priest at Claire's temple,
Diego worked to dispel prejudice against the
goddess Yu Phas and the children of
Damascar. Though he remained aloof to the
end, many who were struck by his sincerity
found themselves drawn to his cause.

text.jp:
ロレッタはクレール神殿に戻ると実に真面目
に日々の務めに取り組み、同僚の神官たちや
神殿を訪れる多くの信徒たちから頼られる神
官として成長する。そこに、かつてのような
不真面目な様子は見られなかったという。
彼女自身が長く望んでいたゾニの養女とな
り、後ろ盾を得た後、幸福に過ごしたといわ
れている。
text.official_en:
After returning to Credna's temple, Loretta
worked diligently at her duties and grew
into a priest trusted by her associates and
many of the temple's visitors. Her blithe
attitude slowly faded as she grew into the
role. Upon Ozin making good on his promise
to adopt her, she lived out a contented life
thanks to his care.
text.real_en:
After returning to Claire's temple, Loretta
worked diligently at her duties and grew
into a priest trusted by her associates and
many of the temple's visitors. Her blithe
attitude slowly faded as she grew into the
role. Upon Zoni making good on his promise
to adopt her, she lived out a contented life
thanks to his care.

text.jp:
セテスは戦後、ダグザの地が徐々に秩序を取
り戻してゆく様子を見届けると、仲間たち
から惜しまれつつフォドラの大地に戻り、ガ
ルグ＝マク大修道院で長い眠りから目覚めて
いた自分の家族と再会を果たす。後にセテス
はダグザの地を訪問中に体験した様々なこと
を膨大な量の書物にまとめ、仔細を大司教に
報告した。この書物は一般に公開されること
はなく、大修道院の大司教の書庫に秘かに保
管されているという。
text.official_en:
After the war, Seteth saw order gradually
return to Dagda. Though his companions
were sad to see him leave, he returned to
Fódlan and reunited with his daughter, who
had awakened from her long slumber at
Garreg Mach Monastery. Later, Seteth
compiled his experiences in Dagda and
presented them to the archbishop. The
book was never made public, and is said
to be secretly stored in the archbishop's
private library at the monastery.

text.jp:
バロールとの戦いを終えて、クレール神殿に
戻ったニネ。噂に名高い黒麗糸のニネを自分
の陣営に引き込みたいと考える権力者たちは
多かったが、ニネはいっさいの誘いを受け流
し、自らはあくまでダグザ神殿の信仰を守る
武力としてのバルカンの立場を貫いていたと
いう。美しい彼女に対し、多くの男たちが浅
からぬ想いを抱き、近づく機会を狙っていた
ともされるが、本人はそれに一切気付くこと
もなく、普段通りの様子だったという。
text.official_en:
After the battle with Balor, Ninae returned
to Credna's temple. Many powerful leaders
sought to recruit the famed Black-Lace
Ninae, but she refused all offers and stayed
loyal as a vulkan protecting the temples.
Many men had more than casual feelings for
the beautiful knight and looked for ways to
earn her favor, but she remained oblivious
and carried on as usual.
text.real_en:
After the battle with Balor, Ninae returned

Ninae, but she refused all offers and stayed

and carried on as usual.

text.jp:
ボナパルテはその卓越した頭脳を活かし、宰
相コン・ムーと共に長きにわたりセオドラを
支え続けたといわれる。ボナパルテの没後か
ら１００年ほどを数えた頃、彼が生前に密か
に書き残していた膨大な量のサラミス王国の
年代史が発見される。それは彼の脳内をその
まま書き出したかのような緻密さで、後世の
歴史家たちから必読書として参照されるほど
の重要な資料となるのだった。
text.official_en:
Bonaventure put his exceptional intellect to
the task of supporting Theodora alongside
Chancellor Kumos for many years. Roughly
one hundred years after his death, the
thorough history of Saramis that he penned
in secret was discovered. His records were
meticulous, as if he had transcribed the
storehouse of his mind, and future historians
came to consider it required reading.
text.real_en:
Bonaparte put his exceptional intellect to
the task of supporting Theodora alongside
Chancellor Kon Mu for many years. Roughly
one hundred years after his death, the
thorough history of Saramis that he penned
in secret was discovered. His records were
meticulous, as if he had transcribed the
storehouse of his mind, and future historians
came to consider it required reading.

text.jp:
セオドラという大きな柱を失い、急速に求心
力を失うサラミス王国を立て直すべく、ボナ
パルテは後継者探しに奔走し、ついに長く消
息不明となっていた王家傍流の血を引く青年
を見つけ出す。彼は年老いたボナパルテの熱
意に絆され、王権の斧の儀式を見事に果たし
セオドラの後を継ぐ王となるのだった。その
様子を眺めるボナパルテは務めを果たしたこ
とに満足しつつも、失ったものの大きさのた
めか、どこか寂しげな様子だったという。
text.official_en:
With the loss of Theodora as a unifying
force, Saramis found itself without a central
pillar. Bonaventure worked hard to find a
successor who could rebuild, eventually
discovering a young man who bore the 
blood of a lost branch of the royal line.
Moved by the aged Bonaventure's zeal, he
performed the Monarch's Axe ceremony
flawlessly and succeeded Theodora. Though
Bonaventure was proud of what he had
accomplished, it is said he still wept to think
of what his kingdom had lost.
text.real_en:
With the loss of Theodora as a unifying

blood of a lost branch of the royal line.
Moved by the aged Bonaparte's zeal, he
performed the Monarch's Axe ceremony
flawlessly and succeeded Theodora. Though
Bonaparte was proud of what he had
accomplished, it is said he still wept to think
of what his kingdom had lost.

text.jp:
戦後も引き続きサラミス王国の将として王を
支える役割についていたトビヤス。頭脳労働
は相変わらず苦手だったこともあり、１０年
ほど経った頃に肉体の衰えを自覚したことを
機にすっぱりと引退する。トビヤスは生涯妻
を娶らず、また晩年まで酒の量も減ることは
なかったため、その最期もひとり酒樽を抱え
たまま、前に倒れ伏しての大往生であったと
いう。孤独で型破りなものの、実に彼らしい
最期だと、トビヤスの人柄をよく知る者は唸
りつつも納得するのだった。
text.official_en:
After the war, Tobias continued to support
the throne of Saramis as a commander. He
was no more of a strategist than ever, so
when he realized 10 years later that his
physical condition was deteriorating, he
chose to retire. Tobias never married, nor
did he decrease his drinking habits—some
say he died peacefully, face down on the
ground with a cask of ale in hand. Though it
was a lonely and ignominious end, those
who knew him well admitted it was within
his character, even as they mourned him.

text.jp:
リリアンはこれまでの戦いで得た金で自分の
生まれ育った屋敷を取り戻すと、長年の望み
だった家族とのんびりと過ごす暮らしを再び
手に入れることができた。その際に退役して
軍からは離れたものの狩猟は趣味として続け
ていたようである。その後は兵士時代に軍で
知り合った気の合う相手を婿に迎え、仲睦ま
じく暮らす様子が見られたという。リリアン
はその人柄と面倒見の良さで、周りのものた
ちからよく頼られたといわれている。
text.official_en:
Lilian used the money she earned through
her battles to buy back her childhood estate
and reestablish a peaceful life with her
family. She retired from the military but
continued to hunt as a hobby. Lilian wed
a man who served with her as a soldier, and
they lived in harmony together. Those who
knew Lilian often relied on her for her
unimpeachable character and caring nature.

text.jp:
ライサンダーは持ち前の勇猛さと聡明さをい
かんなく発揮して活躍、武勲をあげて出世し
てゆき、最終的には宰相を任命され、国家の
舵取りの一端を担うことになる。彼自身の躍
進について、名将と謳われたトビヤスとボナ
パルテ二人の薫陶の賜物だったのではないか
と人から問われることは多かったが、そんな
時ライサンダーはいつも懐かしそうな眼をし
て笑って頷くのだった。
text.official_en:
Lysander used his innate daring and good
sense to distinguish himself as a warrior.
Eventually, he was appointed chancellor
and played a part in steering the kingdom.
Many asked if his quick rise was due to his
mentorship from Bonaventure and Tobias,
known as great commanders, to which
Lysander would always smile and nod with
a nostalgic look in his eyes.
text.real_en:
Lysander used his innate daring and good

Eventually, he was appointed chancellor

text.jp:
冥界戦争が終わった後も、レダの側近として
彼女の為に尽くす道を選ぶバッカニア。「あ
たしを独り身でいることの理由にされたら堪
らないわ」と、レダからは所帯を持つことを
強く勧められ、幾人もの相手を紹介された
もののこれを固辞し、生涯にわたり独身を貫
くのだった。彼の死後、遺体はレダによって
キジェルモの墓の隣に埋葬されたという。
text.official_en:
After the Underworld War, Buccar chose to
continue as Leda's retainer. She urged
Buccar to start a family, saying she didn't
want to be used as an excuse for him to stay
single, and even went so far as to introduce
him to a few prospective partners. In the
end, though, he remained a bachelor for the
rest of his life. After his death, Leda had
him buried beside Guillermo.
text.real_en:
After the Underworld War, Buccaneer chose to
continue as Leda's retainer. She urged
Buccaneer to start a family, saying she didn't
want to be used as an excuse for him to stay
single, and even went so far as to introduce
him to a few prospective partners. In the
end, though, he remained a bachelor for the
rest of his life. After his death, Leda had
him buried beside Quijermo.

text.jp:
冥界戦争の終結後、バッカニアはダグシオン
に腰を据えると、治安維持のためにその力を
活かした。寡黙ではありつつも頼もしい彼は
多くの若い兵士達からよく慕われていたと
いう。やがて、ふとしたきっかけからダグシ
オンで宿を営んでいた未亡人と知り合うと、
数年後には彼女と一緒に暮らすようになり、
三人の子供に恵まれたという。
text.official_en:
After the Underworld War, Buccar settled in
Dagsion and put his skills to work upholding
the peace. He was taciturn but reliable, and
many younger soldiers came to idolize him.
Later on, he happened to meet a widow
who ran a tavern in Dagsion. A few years
later, they began living together and were
eventually blessed with three children.
text.real_en:
After the Underworld War, Buccaneer settled in

the peace. He was taciturn but reliable, and
many younger soldiers came to idolize him.
Later on, he happened to meet a widow
who ran a tavern in Dagsion. A few years
later, they began living together and were
eventually blessed with three children.

text.jp:
バロールとの戦いを終えたシロッコは神殿に
戻ると、カーラ神殿のバルカンとして、以前
以上に多忙な日々を送る。数年の後、シロッ
コは神殿を出る決断をしたカーラに同行し、
共にダグザの地を放浪することとなる。カー
ラはシロッコに対し迷惑そうな素振りをしつ
つもその様子はどこか嬉しそうであったと、
彼の死後１００年が経過してから発見され
た手記の中で綴られていたという。
text.official_en:
After the battle with Balor, Sirocco returned
to his work as a vulkan of Kalla's temple.
His life became even busier than before.
Several years later, when Kalla elected to
leave the temples, Sirocco joined her, and
the two wandered the land of Dagda
together. Though Kalla seemed outwardly
annoyed by Sirocco, a journal discovered
a hundred years after his death revealed
that she was always pleased to have
him around.
text.real_en:
After the battle with Balor, Sirocco returned
to his work as a vulkan of Cara's temple.
His life became even busier than before.
Several years later, when Cara elected to
leave the temples, Sirocco joined her, and
the two wandered the land of Dagda
together. Though Cara seemed outwardly
annoyed by Sirocco, a journal discovered
a hundred years after his death revealed
that she was always pleased to have
him around.

text.jp:
ムウはかつて自分の母であるミカエラが望ん
でいた通りスミルノス神殿に入り、膨大な量
の蔵書を読み解きながら勉強の日々を送る。
真面目な彼女のことをスミルノスも気に入っ
た様子だったという。神殿に勤めながら彼女
の生み出した数々の薬が、いつしか魔道で救
えるよりも多くの命を救うようになるのだっ
た。のちに彼女は、ダグザの地において薬学
を大きく発展させた重要な人物として歴史上
で語り継がれることとなる。
text.official_en:
As her mother, Mikaela, once hoped, Mu
apprenticed at Smyrnos's temple and spent
her days poring over the vast collection of
books kept there. The god himself was said
to have taken a shine to her for her
diligence. While working at the temple, she
invented a number of medicines, eventually
saving more lives than magic could ever
hope to. History would remember her as an
important figure in the advancement of
pharmaceuticals in Dagda.

text.jp:
ミカエラは傭兵としてダグザの地を渡り歩き
戦い続ける日々を送る。各地の権力者たちか
ら好待遇での仕官の誘いもいくつかあったよ
うだが、それらすべてを固辞したという。ミ
カエラは傭兵稼業で稼いだ金を使い、行き場
を失った者達を支援する施設を作り、その施
設長と傭兵の二足の草鞋を履いて活動を続け
る。最期はとある戦場で、仲間たちの殿を務
めた際、追撃してきた敵を止めるためにその
命を散らすこととなるのだった。
text.official_en:
Mikaela went on to travel Dagda as a
mercenary, spending her days fighting.
Many influential figures across the land
offered her favorable positions, but she
declined them all. Using the money earned
from her mercenary work, she established a
foundation to support those who had lost
their place in the world, acting as its
director in between mercenary jobs. She
met her end on the battlefield defending her
allies' retreat, laying down her life to stop
the enemy's pursuit.

text.jp:
オリンピアはたゆまぬ努力が認められてカー
ラ神殿の祭司となり、その後も芸術と文化の
守護者として積極的な活動を行った。最終的
に大祭司にまで上り詰め、カエルスにその人
ありと、皆からの尊敬を集める存在となる。
自らの考えによって身を引いた女神カーラが
いつか神殿に戻ると信じ、それまでの間神殿
を守り抜くことを誓って日夜奮闘を続けるオ
リンピアだったが、残念ながら彼女が存命の
内にその機会が訪れることはなかったとされ
ている。
text.official_en:
For her tireless efforts, Olympia was made a
lead priest in Kalla's temple, where she
continued to act as a patron of the arts.
She eventually rose to the rank of high
priest, a position that earned her the respect
of all who knew her in Caelus. Believing
that the goddess Kalla, who left the temples
of her own volition, would return, Olympia
vowed to safeguard the temple until that
day arrived. Alas, she did not live to see her
goddess's return.
text.real_en:
For her tireless efforts, Olympia was made a
lead priest in Cara's temple, where she
continued to act as a patron of the arts.
She eventually rose to the rank of high
priest, a position that earned her the respect
of all who knew her in Caelus. Believing
that the goddess Cara, who left the temples
of her own volition, would return, Olympia
vowed to safeguard the temple until that
day arrived. Alas, she did not live to see her
goddess's return.

text.jp:
ナジャは自らの残り短い生を少しでも悔いの
ないものにすべく、さらなる強者を求めて海
を越え、ダグザの地の外にある世界を放浪し
ていた。過酷な旅は心核を持たないナジャに
とって負担が大きく、旅の途中ですでに肉体
の老化が始まっており、その症状に苦しめら
れつつも彼が足を止めることはなかった。
ナジャが東のラーマ国に至った際、その土地
で新しい師に出会ったことで悟りに至り、そ
こからは穏やかな余生を送ったという。
text.official_en:
To make the most of his few years left,
Nezha crossed the sea and traveled beyond
the land of Dagda in search of a stronger
opponents. Though his lack of a Heart Core
took a heavy toll on him during the harsh
journey, he never stopped moving forward.
When Nezha arrived in the eastern land of
Rama, he met a new master and found
enlightenment, spending the rest of his days
in peace.
text.real_en:
To make the most of his few years left,
Naja crossed the sea and traveled beyond
the land of Dagda in search of a stronger
opponents. Though his lack of a Heart Core

journey, he never stopped moving forward.
When Naja arrived in the eastern land of

enlightenment, spending the rest of his days
in peace.

text.jp:
サランはダグシオンに拠点を移すと、ついに
念願だった料理店を開く。彼女の料理はたち
まち大人気となり、店の前には常に行列が絶
えなかったという。実際のところ、客のうち
何割かは利発なサランとの会話を楽しむこと
も目的としていたようである。商才あるサラ
ンはそこから人脈を広げていきやがて大きな
商家をひらくと白き卵の民に縁を持つ者たち
を多く雇い入れ、忙しい日々を送ったといわ
れている。
text.official_en:
After relocating to Dagsion, Sha Lan finally
opened the restaurant she'd long dreamed
of. Her food became wildly popular,
attracting long lines of customers each day...
though many of them came just for the
sparkling conversation. Thanks to her sharp
business sense, Sha Lan began a franchise
and eventually founded a major trading
house. Many of her employees had ties to
the People of the White Egg, and she led
a busy and prosperous life.
text.real_en:
After relocating to Dagsion, Sarang finally
opened the restaurant she'd long dreamed
of. Her food became wildly popular,
attracting long lines of customers each day...
though many of them came just for the
sparkling conversation. Thanks to her sharp
business sense, Sarang began a franchise
and eventually founded a major trading
house. Many of her employees had ties to
the People of the White Egg, and she led
a busy and prosperous life.

text.jp:
ダイトウは鍛冶の神クレールのもとに弟子入
りし、そこで多くのことを学ぶ。後に彼はそ
の明晰な頭脳と白き卵の民としての知識、そ
してクレールから授かった数々の技術で人々
のために貢献することとなる。幾人もの弟子
を育て上げ、多くの者たちからも尊敬される
人生だったが生涯未婚であり、その点に関し
て本人としては別に意図したわけではなかっ
たようで、最後まで納得のいかない様子だっ
たという。
text.official_en:
Dadao became an apprentice to Credna,
the god of blacksmithing, and learned a lot
under his tutelage. His sharp mind,
combined with the knowledge of the People
of the White Egg and the skills Credna
taught him, later helped him make a
difference in people's lives. He trained many
apprentices and was widely respected.
Though he never married, he always hoped
it would be in the cards and never quite
made his peace with the bachelor life.
text.real_en:
Daitou became an apprentice to Claire,
the god of blacksmithing, and learned a lot
under his tutelage. His sharp mind,
combined with the knowledge of the People
of the White Egg and the skills Claire
taught him, later helped him make a
difference in people's lives. He trained many
apprentices and was widely respected.
Though he never married, he always hoped
it would be in the cards and never quite
made his peace with the bachelor life.

text.jp:
ハルヴィンは戦いで得た資金と冥界戦争の英
雄としての名声により一家が借りていた土地
を地主から買い上げ、家族の元に戻るという
彼女の念願を果たす。その後は皆で仲良く暮
らしながら自分たちの農園を盛り立てたとい
う。彼女たちの手によって栽培されたオリバ
は特に実が大粒で品質がよいとダグザの地で
も有名になり「ハルヴィン種」という名で広
く流通するようになるのだった。
text.official_en:
Using the funds earned from her stint as a
hero of the Underworld War, Halvin bought
the land her family had rented, fulfilling her
long-held dream of returning home. The
oliva plants her family grew became known
throughout Dagda for their large, high-
quality fruit, and soon came to be
distributed under the name "Halvin-Brand."

text.jp:
長い戦いを終え、平凡な日常に戻ったグザラ
ン。冥界戦争の英雄の肩書を得てからも、彼
の様子は以前と全く変わることはなかった。
どこの国にも所属せずいつも盛り場を渡り歩
き、何者にも媚びず、なびかず、気が向いた
らホラを吹き、時折舞い込んでくる傭兵とし
ての依頼を手堅くこなしながらその後２０年
ほど生きたといわれる。掴みどころがないも
のの、明るく親切なグザランの人柄は多くの
者達から頼りにされ、愛されたという。
text.official_en:
After the long war, Guzran returned to his
normal life. Even after earning fame as one
of the heroes of the Underworld War, his
behavior never changed. He held allegiance
to no country, wandered constantly through
entertainment districts, never flattered or
pandered, lied when he felt like it, and
steadily completed what mercenary requests
came his way. He lived for about 20 years
after the war, and despite his abrasive ways,
Guzran's innate cheerfulness and kindness
made him beloved by many.

text.jp:
ヨーカイは仲間たちの前からいつの間にか姿
を消し、以後二度とダグザの地で彼の姿を目
撃したものはいなかったとされる。ヨーカイ
の最期については、酒を飲みすぎてどこかで
行き倒れたとも、フォドラに渡ったとも、あ
るいは東のサイの国で権力者に気に入られ、
宮廷魔道士として取り立てられたといった具
合に実に様々な説があるが、いずれもそれを
裏付ける記録は何もなく、永劫にわたって謎
のまま語り継がれることになるのであった。
text.official_en:
One day, Yang Jie vanished without a word,
and no one in Dagda ever saw him again.
There were many theories about his final
moments. Some say he drank too much and
collapsed somewhere, others believed he
crossed the sea to Fódlan, and a few
suggested he had powerful patrons in the
land of Sai, who appointed him as their
court magician. But none of these theories
had any supporting evidence, and his story
remains a mystery to this day.
text.real_en:
One day, Yookai vanished without a word,
and no one in Dagda ever saw him again.
There were many theories about his final
moments. Some say he drank too much and
