crossed the sea to Fódlan, and a few
suggested he had powerful patrons in the
land of Sai, who appointed him as their
court magician. But none of these theories
had any supporting evidence, and his story
remains a mystery to this day.

text.jp:
イオは祖国であるアラゴ王国に戻る。彼は戦
後の混乱が長く続く中、人々が苦しんでいる
様を見て、改めて騎士としてアラゴ王国に仕
官することを決意するのだった。イオはこれ
までの戦いの中で、忠義ではなく民のために
尽くすという、自分のあるべき騎士の姿をつ
いに見出すことができたのだった。その後も
イオは目覚ましい活躍を遂げ、彼の名はアラ
ゴ王国の領内のみならず、ダグザの地全域に
知れ渡るほどになるのだった。
text.official_en:
Io returned to his homeland of Arago. When
he saw its people suffering in the chaos that
followed the war, he decided to serve his
country as a knight once more. Through his
many battles, Io finally found his oath as a
knight—to serve the people rather than any
master. He achieved many remarkable feats,
and his name was known not only within
Arago, but throughout the land of Dagda.

text.jp:
ダグザの地における数々の経験は、ペペを王
として大きく成長させることとなった。ブリ
ギットに戻った後、ペペは各国との外交はも
とより内政にまで抜かりなくその力を発揮、
祖国をさらなる発展に導いたという。
執務に追われる日々の中、ときおり彼は思い
出したようにダグザの地で出会ったという想
い人について、いかに素晴らしい女性だった
かを周囲のものたちに力説しては深いため息
をついていたと言われている。
text.official_en:
Peppe's experiences in the land of Dagda
helped him mature as a king. After his
return to Brigid, he demonstrated what he
learned not just in relations with other
countries, but in domestic policy as well,
leading his kingdom to further prosperity.
Despite all that kept him busy, from time to
time he was said to sigh deeply as he
recalled a woman he had met in Dagda,
just before waxing poetic to those around
him of her many charms.
text.real_en:
Pepe's experiences in the land of Dagda
helped him mature as a king. After his
return to Brigid, he demonstrated what he
learned not just in relations with other
countries, but in domestic policy as well,
leading his kingdom to further prosperity.
Despite all that kept him busy, from time to
time he was said to sigh deeply as he
recalled a woman he had met in Dagda,
just before waxing poetic to those around
him of her many charms.

text.jp:
ノクチュラはダグシオンに住居用の家を購入
すると、復興を手伝いながらしばらくの間は
都会暮らしを満喫していたが、ある時期から
人間関係に疲れを感じるようになり、生まれ
育った里に戻ったといわれる。冥界戦争を戦
い抜いた彼女は一族の中でも特別視されるこ
とになった。数多い兄弟たちからの推薦もあ
り、親の後を継いでアーシラー族の長の座に
ついたノクチュラは、その裏表のない人柄で
一族をしっかりとまとめ上げつつ、周囲から
愛されたと伝えられている。
text.official_en:
Noctula bought a house in Dagsion and
enjoyed city life for a time while helping
with the rebuilding efforts. But at a certain
point, she tired of maintaining relationships
and returned to the village where she was
raised. Her experience in the Underworld
War earned her special treatment within her
clan, and on her siblings' recommendation,
she became the new chief of the Asherah.
Her no-nonsense personality kept the
clan united in their love for their chief.
text.real_en:
Noctura bought a house in Dagsion and
enjoyed city life for a time while helping
with the rebuilding efforts. But at a certain
point, she tired of maintaining relationships
and returned to the village where she was
raised. Her experience in the Underworld
War earned her special treatment within her
clan, and on her siblings' recommendation,
she became the new chief of the Asherah.
Her no-nonsense personality kept the
clan united in their love for their chief.

text.jp:
ソフィアはダグザの地の各地を渡り歩きなが
ら、自らが敬愛するソレルの素晴らしさを説
いて回った。長きにわたる彼女の活動は２０
年後ついに実を結び、神殿から「ソレル派」
として認められることになる。後年ソフィア
は生涯をその布教のために尽くした名物神官
としてダグザ史に名を残すことになるが、そ
の旅の道中ではよく腹を減らして行き倒れた
彼女の姿が目撃されていたという。
text.official_en:
Sofia traveled around the land of Dagda,
preaching the virtues of Solel, whom she
admired and respected. Her work bore fruit
after 20 years when the temples recognized
her followers as the Solel sect. In later years,
Sofia's name came to be known by
historians as a notable priest who
devoted her whole life to spreading her
beliefs, but these same histories noted that
she was often seen collapsed on the road in
her travels due to hunger.
text.real_en:
Sofia traveled around the land of Dagda,
preaching the virtues of Sorell, whom she
admired and respected. Her work bore fruit
after 20 years when the temples recognized
her followers as the Sorell sect. In later years,
Sofia's name came to be known by
historians as a notable priest who
devoted her whole life to spreading her
beliefs, but these same histories noted that
she was often seen collapsed on the road in
her travels due to hunger.

text.jp:
世界の命運を左右するような苛烈な戦いを生
き延びたカターニャは、自分が仕えるべき主
を求めてダグザの地を巡っていたが、ふとし
た機会からカスタリア地方のとある有力な軍
人のもとに身を寄せることになる。その後も
カターニャは実に彼女らしく、目覚ましくも
賑やかにいくつかの大活躍をし、結果、後世
の歴史家によってダグザ史に名を残すことと
なるのである。
text.official_en:
Having survived a grueling battle for the
fate of the world, Catania traveled Dagda in
search of a lord to serve. A chance meeting
led her to an influential soldier in the
Castalia region. She served her lord well,
going on to accomplish many spectacular
feats of combat, and her name went down
in the histories of Dagda.

text.jp:
長く離れていたサラミスに戻ったヌディーヌ
は士官として取り立てられ、再び祖国のため
に尽力することとなる。その後、彼女は現役
を退いてからも教官として後進の指導にあた
り、数多くの優秀な兵士たちを育て上げるの
だった。またヌディーヌは多くの男達から求
婚されたが、彼女の眼鏡に適った相手はつい
に現れなかったらしく、終生独身を貫いたと
いわれている。
text.official_en:
Nydine returned to Saramis after her long
absence and was promoted as an officer to
once again serve her homeland. Later, after
retiring from active service, she taught
future generations in combat, raising many
talented warriors. Though several men
sought her hand in marriage, none ever met
her standards, and she remained unmarried
throughout her life.

text.jp:
ザーコネは自らの本拠地であるカエルス地方
に戻ると山賊稼業を再開し、悪事の限りを尽
くした。噂を聞きつけた周囲の悪漢たちも彼
の元へ合流し、新生ガイア旅団は一大勢力へ
と成長していく。やがて中央に目をつけられ
大規模な討伐軍が差し向けられることにな
る。ザーコネは投降を呼びかける声にも耳を
貸さず勇猛に戦うもついに討ち取られ、その
屍を野に晒すことになるのだった。ザーコネ
は略奪する相手には容赦のない、凶暴で残虐
な男ではあったが、部下たちからは不思議と
よく慕われていたという。
text.official_en:
Zarcone returned to his base in Caelus and
went back to his life of crime. Hearing word
of his exploits, other ruffians in the region
joined up with him, and the Gaia Brigade
became a major force. They were successful
enough that the central government took
notice and sent a strike team to deal with
them. Zarcone refused all calls for surrender
and fought to the last, but was killed and left
to rot where he fell. Though he was cruel
and merciless to his victims, his crew
always spoke kindly of him.

text.jp:
バロールとの戦いを終えた後、マジーデもま
た英雄として周囲から持ち上げられ、ダグシ
オンで居心地よく過ごすことになる。しばら
くのうちは人気があったものの、生来の乱暴
な素行が収まることもなく、以前と同じよう
に暴力事件を起こしては投獄と脱獄を繰り返
すことになったという。マジーデは最終的に
ダグシオンを追放され、恨み言を言いつつ南
のほうに去っていったといわれている。
text.official_en:
After the battle with Balor, Majide was
hailed as a hero by those around him. He
lived comfortably in Dagsion for a time and
was well liked until his violent nature got
the better of him. Just as before, he was in
and out of prison and eventually banished
from Dagsion. He was believed to have
left for southern regions, complaining all
the while.

text.jp:
ベンディッツはバロールと戦い抜いた功績に
より、ダグザ帝国に念願の将軍の待遇でもっ
て取り立てられる。ついに長年夢にまで見た
宿願を果たしたベンディッツだったが、運悪
くその頃から重い腰痛を発症するようになり
早々に引退することを余儀なくされるのだっ
た。不本意な隠棲生活に移らざるをえなかっ
た彼だが、周囲に対し自分はもとダグザ帝国
の偉大なる将軍だと、以前よりいっそう誇ら
しげに語る様子がよく見られたという。
text.official_en:
Due to his distinguished service in seeing
the fight against Balor through to the end,
Benditz achieved his heart's desire and was
appointed a general of the Dagdan Empire.
Unfortunately, it was at that time that he
began to suffer severe lower back pain,
forcing him into an early retirement. Despite
being dumped back into civilian life, he
boasted more loudly than ever about his
days as a distinguished Dagdan general.

text.jp:
イニオニは冥界戦争の終結後は出身地の村に
戻ると狩人として生涯を終える。彼女自らが
積極的に触れ回ることはなかったが、世界を
危機から救うため勇敢にバロールへ立ち向
かったイニオニは地元の戦士たちの誇りとし
て末永く語り継がれることとなり、老若男女
幅広い者たちから大いに尊敬されたといわれ
ている。
text.official_en:
After the Underworld War, Inyoni went
back to her hometown and spent her life as
a hunter. Though she tended to downplay it,
her bravery in standing up to Balor to save
the world was boasted of for generations
as a point of pride for the local warriors. She
was greatly respected by all sorts—men and
women, young and old.

text.jp:
救世主と共に戦った英雄としてその名を世に
轟かせたジャスミンは、ついに念願だった傭
兵団の再結成を果たす。彼女の傭兵団はその
後しばらくは戦後の混乱の続く各地を転々と
しながら多くの人々を守るのだった。１０年
後、自らの体力に限界を感じたジャスミンは
傭兵団を解散すると傭兵稼業からも引退し、
仲間たちから惜しまれながらも、生まれ育っ
たブリギットの地に戻った。その際、別れを
惜しんだ者の何人かは彼女を追って海を渡っ
ていってしまったという。
text.official_en:
Having made a name for herself as a hero
who fought alongside the Promised One,
Jasmine finally achieved her dream of 
reuniting her mercenary group. They
traveled the land, protecting those who
needed it during this time of chaos. Ten
years later, no longer in her prime, Jasmine
disbanded the group and retired. Over her
friends' protests, she returned to her
homeland of Brigid. Several of her friends
were so distraught by her departure that
they followed her across the sea.

text.jp:
アレキサンドラは生家と思い出の残されたテ
ルス郡に戻り、地元の神殿で人々のために尽
くす道を選ぶ。それは決して平坦な道ではな
かったが充実した日々を送ったようである。
アレキサンドラのもとには幾人もの求婚者
が現れたが、彼女が首を縦にふることはなく
生涯独身を貫いたという。どんな時でも常
に穏やかなアレキサンドラだったが、伯父が
関係の修復を図り接近した際には、鬼気迫る
剣幕でこれを拒絶したという。
text.official_en:
Alexandra returned to Tellus, where her
memories of her family were strongest, and
chose the path of serving the people at her
local temple. It was a difficult life, but she
found the work fulfilling. Many suitors
approached Alexandra, but she accepted
none of them and remained single all her
life. Though Alexandra was generally mild
mannered, when her uncle approached her
to mend their relationship, she rejected the
overture with bloodcurdling venom.

text.jp:
死力を尽くして戦い抜き、すべてに決着をつ
けた後もコウカの罪の意識は薄まることがな
かった。彼女は独り山奥に庵を造り、人と接
しないようにしながらしばらくの間ひっそり
と暮らしつつ、己が成すべき事は何かを問い
続ける日々を送っていたが、あるとき自分の
ように迷えるものを救うという答えを見出し
旅立ったとされる。かつてコウカ自身が追い
続けた白き救世主の背中を思い描きながら。
text.official_en:
Even after fighting with all her strength to
atone for her sins, Hong Hua still felt a
sense of guilt. She built a hermitage deep in
the mountains and lived quietly for a time,
avoiding contact with people. There, she
continued to meditate on what she should
be doing. One day, she concluded that the
proper path was to help those who were as
lost as she was. She set out on a pilgrimage,
all the while envisioning the savior in white
whom she herself once followed.
text.real_en:
Even after fighting with all her strength to
atone for her sins, Kouka still felt a
sense of guilt. She built a hermitage deep in
the mountains and lived quietly for a time,
avoiding contact with people. There, she
continued to meditate on what she should
be doing. One day, she concluded that the
proper path was to help those who were as
lost as she was. She set out on a pilgrimage,
all the while envisioning the savior in white
whom she herself once followed.

text.jp:
アウロラから妻を娶って自分の家庭を持つよ
う言い渡されたセントリオンは、以前から彼
に好意を抱いていた神官の女性を紹介され、
共に暮らすようになった。セントリオンは、
始めこそぎこちない様子ではあったものの幸
福な家庭を築いたという。妻との間に子供を
授かり、子育てに翻弄されるうちに、彼の生
来の石頭はいくぶん柔らかくなった様子だっ
たとのことである。
text.official_en:
Ordered by Aurora to take a wife and start
a family, Centurio was introduced to a
priest to whom he'd always been favorably
disposed and began a new life with her.
Though he was an awkward husband, they
nevertheless made a happy home between
them. The wedded couple was blessed with
one child, who ran them ragged, but the
experience did much to soften Centurio's
innate stubbornness.

text.jp:
アスワンはアラゴ王国の女王の立場として、
戦後ベルトランから持ち掛けられた構想に賛
同し、これに合流。彼女はその後も引き続き
旧アラゴ王国領を領主として治める。聡明な
アスワンは特に内政においてその手腕を発揮
し、彼女の在位中、旧アラゴ王国領は非常に
安定した治世により、豊かな繁栄を迎えたと
後世に伝えられている。
text.official_en:
As queen of Arago, Aswan agreed to
Bertrand's vision for the Dagdan Alliance
and joined it at an early stage. She
continued to oversee the territory of Arago
even after entering into the alliance. Aswan
was a wise governor, especially when it
came to domestic policy. Through her
guidance, the former kingdom of Arago
entered into a period of renewed stability
and prosperity.

text.jp:
アスワンは女王としての責任から、アラゴ王
国の国内を安定させるために力を注いだ。そ
れから２０年の後、領内の辺境にある村の視
察中に王家に深い恨みを持つ者によって襲撃
され、その凶刃に倒れることとなる。聡明で
心優しいアスワンの突然の死を、多くの国民
や兵士たちが悲しんだといわれる。
text.official_en:
As queen of Arago, Aswan devoted herself
to stabilizing her country. But 20 years later,
during a tour of the kingdom's border, she
was attacked by a man with a deep-seated
grudge against the royal family and fell to
his blade. Many citizens and soldiers of
Arago mourned the death of their wise and
kindhearted queen.

text.jp:
タホウニアはその生涯においてアスワンの
側で甲斐甲斐しく世話を焼きつつ、身辺の
警護に身を尽くした。アスワンを狙った
暗殺者はことごとく彼女によって阻まれ、
難攻不落のタホウニアと呼ばれるのだった。
彼女のピュトーン流格闘術については、
グラン・アラゴンの城下町で見出した才能
ある若者に伝授され、正しく未来へと継承
されることになる。その若者は後の世で
拳聖として広くその名を知られることになる
のだが、それはまた別の場所で語られるべき
話であろう。
text.official_en:
Tahonia spent her life by Aswan's side,
caring for her and keeping her safe. She
vigorously shut down threats on Aswan's
life, becoming known as Tahonia the
Impassable. She taught her Python style
of fighting to a talented youth she met in
Grand Aragon's castle town, ensuring it
would be passed down in the future. The
youth would later come to be a well-known
martial artist, but that is a story for
another time.

text.jp:
祖国に戻ったネイサンは改めて王に対し忠誠
を尽くすことを誓うと、いまだ混乱が残る領
内の各地を治めるために奔走するのだった。
また彼はその生涯において後進の育成にもよ
く力を注いだとされる。常に戦いの最前線に
立ち続けた彼はその後も様々な事件に立ち会
うこととなり、結果として吟遊詩人たちに語
り継がれる逸話を幾つも生み出すことになる
が、何があろうとも生真面目な性格は一切ぶ
れることがなかったという。
text.official_en:
After returning to his homeland, Nathan 
once again pledged his loyalty to the throne
and worked to bring order to the parts of
Arago still in turmoil. All the while, he
devoted himself to training the next
generation of warriors. From his vantage
point on the front lines of battle, he saw
many major events firsthand, inspiring a
good number of bards to portray him. Yet
despite it all, his earnest forthrightness
never faltered.

text.jp:
あれほどの戦いを経てもキリークの斜に構え
た性格が変わることはなかったが、以前より
も少し柔らかくなったと他人から指摘される
ことは増えたようだ。この点についてキリー
ク本人は「馬鹿な連中に絆されたからだ」と
周囲に説明していた模様である。数年後、キ
リークは辺境を視察中に突如病を患い、グラ
ン・アラゴンに戻る暇もなくそのまま現地で
息を引き取ってしまうのだが、最後まで軽口
を叩いていたために、近くの者が彼の深刻な
病状に気づかなかった為ともいわれている。
text.official_en:
Even after experiencing so much strife,
Creek never gave up his cynical nature,
though some noted that he softened ever
so slightly. Creek himself explained this
away by saying it was the consequence of
being forced to follow stupid orders. A few
years later, Creek fell ill during a border
inspection and passed away before he could
be returned to Grand Aragon. Because he
kept up his gallows humor until the end,
those around him never realized the gravity
of his illness.

text.jp:
ダナン海に戻ったキロイカは荒くれ者どもを
勧誘し、自らの海賊団を再び組織すると海賊
活動を再開する。その後、ヴァンダル商会と
も洋上でたびたび衝突することとなるが、彼
の中の幽霊に対する恐怖心は根深いものがあ
り、そのため自ら先陣を切ることはめっきり
と減り、襲撃はもっぱら部下任せになってし
まっていたという。最期はダグザ帝国の海軍
に拠点を襲撃され、部下ともども奮闘するも
壮絶な討ち死にを遂げたといわれている。
text.official_en:
After returning to the Danann Sea, Kiroc
recruited some roughnecks, reformed his
band of ne'er-do-wells, and picked up the
pirate life where he left off. He frequently
clashed with Vandahl Trading on the high
seas, though his deep-rooted fear of ghosts
prevented him from fighting on the front
lines. In the end, the Dagdan Empire's navy
struck at his base, and despite his heroic
efforts, he and his crew fell in battle.

text.jp:
ヌッツォはバロール神殿の守り人を買って出
ると、一人でバロールの島に移り住んだ。か
つて自分たちが崇拝を捧げながら刃を向ける
ことになってしまった魔神のことを弔いなが
ら、その終生にわたって神なき後の神殿を静
かに見守り続けるのだった。
尚、しばらく後にヌッツォをよく慕っていた
部下たちが海を渡って彼の元に押しかけ、島
の中に築いた集落で共に厳かな暮らしを送っ
たと伝えられていることを、ここに追記して
おく。
text.official_en:
Nuzzuo volunteered to guard Balor's temple
and lived alone on the Isle of Balor. He kept
watch over the empty temple until the end
of his days, mourning the demon god his
people worshipped before their great
apostasy. However, it should be noted that
after some time, a few like-minded Har Hali
crossed the sea to reach Nuzzuo, where they
built a settlement on the island and lived a
stoic life together.

text.jp:
客将として世界の命運を賭けた戦いを見届け
たクラプカはモーザに戻ると、オクタル王に
事の顛末を報告する。オクタル王はいたく感
動し、クラプカは異国にモーザの名を轟かせ
た勇士として多くの褒美を授かるのだった。
彼はその後もモーザの烈将として前線で戦い
続けることとなったが、南方のレーザレオン
王国との戦闘中に命を落としたと言われる。
text.official_en:
When Klapka returned to the Mosa, having
seen the war for the fate of the world as a
guest general, he reported the whole story
to King Oktar. The king was greatly
impressed by Klapka winning renown for
the Mosa in a foreign land, and rewarded
the brave general handsomely. Klapka
continued to fight on the front lines as a
Mosa officer and is believed to have
perished in a battle against the kingdom of
Lezeraon to the south.

text.jp:
人類の未来を賭けた戦いの結末を見届けたト
ロイアはひっそりと仲間たちの前から姿を消
した。その後は自らの祠でもとのような静か
な暮らしに戻ったという。同胞たちをはじめ
この地に残された偉大なる石標たちを見守り
ながら、以後も長きにわたってコンロンの守
り人として自らの責務を果たしたという。彼
女が最終的にいつ頃まで活動を続けていたの
かは、いかなる記録にも明確な情報としては
残されていない。
text.official_en:
Having secured a future for humanity, Troy
quietly slipped away from her allies. Many
believed that she returned to her peaceful
life at her shrine—though she kept up her
duty as guardian of Kunlun for years to
come, watching over her kin and the Grand
Megaliths across the land. There is no
record of how long her vigil lasted.

text.jp:
リベイラ村に戻り、読書をしながら療養生活
を送っていたが、地震が起こった際に崩れた
本の下敷きになり死亡する。
text.official_en:
Tialla returned to Ribeira, where she read
avidly as she convalesced. But when an
earthquake struck, she was killed beneath
the weight of her shelves.
text.real_en:
Tiara returned to Ribeira, where she read
avidly as she convalesced. But when an
earthquake struck, she was killed beneath
the weight of her shelves.

text.jp:
リベイラ村に戻り平穏な日々を取り戻したが
病にかかり、家族に看取られながらひっそり
と息を引き取る。
text.official_en:
Peter returned to his tranquil life in Ribeira.
But it wasn't long before he fell gravely ill
and, under his family's care, drew his
last breath.

text.jp:
自分の家族とともに出身地に帰郷し身を潜め
ていたが、大剣闘祭の中で負った傷がもとで
息を引き取る。
text.official_en:
Ultand quietly withdrew to her hometown to
be with her family. But a persistent wound
sustained in the Heroic Games festered,
causing her to breathe her last.

text.jp:
故郷に戻り、家族を連れてアラゴ王国から脱
出しようとするも、彼の家を監視していた陽
炎の騎士団に発見され、殺害される。
text.official_en:
He returned home and tried to flee Arago
with his family. But the Order of the Haze
had been keeping an eye on their house
and wasted no time getting retribution.

text.jp:
ダグシオンに残り、剣闘士として戦う日常に
戻っていたが、復活したダグザ大帝の命によ
り他の剣闘士たちと一緒にダグザの大釜で処
刑される。
text.official_en:
He returned to his life as a gladiator in
Dagsion. On the orders of the resurrected
Emperor Dagda, he and the other gladiators
were put to death in Dagda's cauldron.

text.jp:
大剣闘祭の終了とともに母国に戻ったが、領
内の集落の視察中に魔獣に襲撃され、部下を
逃がし死亡する。
text.official_en:
He returned to his motherland after the
Heroic Games. While he was inspecting
one of the settlements in his territory, a
monster attacked, and he sacrificed himself
to let his underlings escape.

text.jp:
大剣闘祭の終了後、ダグシオンに残り新作の
執筆にいそしんでいたが、復活したダグザ大
帝の命によりダグザの大釜で処刑される。
text.official_en:
She remained in Dagsion, where she busied
herself with penning a new script. On the
orders of the resurrected Emperor Dagda,
she was put to death in Dagda's cauldron.

text.jp:
仲間たちの前から静かに去り、以後、ダグザ
の地で彼の姿を見たものは誰もいない。
text.official_en:
Fabio quietly slipped away from his allies.
Not a trace of him was ever seen thereafter
in the land of Dagda.

text.jp:
大剣闘祭で負った傷を癒すために一旦は故郷
であるフィーナの漁村に戻ったものの、気晴
らしも兼ねて漁に出た際に高波を受けて船が
転覆し、そのまま消息を絶つ。
text.official_en:
Though she returned to her fishing village
to recuperate from the wounds she received
in the Heroic Games, an ill-fated fishing
expedition spelled disaster for Esmeralda.
Her boat was struck by a tidal wave and
capsized, which was the last anyone ever
saw of her.

text.jp:
彼女の乗ったヴァンダル商会の商船が航海中
に海賊の襲撃に遭い、奮戦するも不意を突か
れ、無念の討ち死にを果たす。
text.official_en:
While she was sailing aboard a Vandahl
Trading Company merchant vessel, the ship
was boarded by pirates. Though she fought
fiercely to fend them off, she was
overwhelmed and tragically killed.

text.jp:
ヴァンダル商会を離れ、気ままな傭兵暮らし
に戻ったものの、とある戦場で味方の裏切り
にあい、戦死する。
text.official_en:
He left Vandahl Trading to return to a freer
life as a mercenary. Unfortunately, a
member of his company betrayed him on
the battlefield, and he perished.

text.jp:
親元に戻っていたが、訓練中の事故により大
けがを負い昏睡状態になる。彼女は結局、
それから意識を取り戻すことなく数年後に
息を引き取ったという。
text.official_en:
She returned to her family's home but was
gravely injured during training and fell into
a coma. She never regained consciousness
and passed away several years later.

text.jp:
ヴァンダル商会での業務中、何者かから派遣
された暗殺者に襲撃され、死亡する。
text.official_en:
While on a job for the Vandahl Trading
Company, she came under attack from
assassins dispatched by an unknown party.
She lost her life to their blades.

text.jp:
戦いの中で負った傷を癒すための秘薬を求め
て南部の森を訪れるも、昔のディエゴを知る
ハル・ハリ族の生き残りから裏切り者として
殺される。
text.official_en:
Diego visited the southern forest in search
of a secret remedy to heal his injuries from
battle, but a survivor of the Har Hali
recognized him from their shared past and
slew him for betraying them.
text.real_en:
Diego visited the southern forest in search
of a secret remedy to heal his injuries from
battle, but a survivor of the Har-Hari
recognized him from their shared past and
slew him for betraying them.

text.jp:
ダグシオンを離れ、ゾニのいるクレール神殿
に戻るも、戦闘で負った傷がもとで倒れ、帰
らぬ人となる。
text.official_en:
Though she managed to escape Dagsion
and return to Ozin at Credna's temple,
her wounds were too severe and she
passed away.
text.real_en:
Though she managed to escape Dagsion
and return to Zoni at Claire's temple,
her wounds were too severe and she
passed away.

text.jp:
ダグザの地の滞在中に負った傷を癒すために
フォドラ行きの商船を探していたが、幸運な
ことに丁度よい便に乗り込むことができ、か
らくも帰還を果たす。
text.official_en:
The wounds he sustained in Dagda were
severe enough for him to seek a merchant
ship back to Fódlan. Luckily, he found a
suitable vessel and managed to return home.

text.jp:
復活したダグザ大帝からの招集を無視し逃亡
兵になるも、多数のバルカンからの追撃を受
け、激戦の果てに壮絶な最期を遂げる。
text.official_en:
She ignored a summons from the
resurrected Dagda the Great. In response,
he branded her a deserter and sent the
vulkans after her. She met a tragic end
after a fierce last stand.

text.jp:
軍を離れ、一人で生活していたが、狩りに出
た際に密林の中で毒蛇に噛まれ、死亡する。
text.official_en:
Lilian left the army to live alone but died
after a venomous snake bit her while she
was hunting in a dense forest.

text.jp:
サラミスの伯父の家に戻り療養生活を送って
いたが、遠乗りに出た際に落馬し、帰らぬ人
となる。
text.official_en:
Lysander returned to his uncle's house in
Saramis to recuperate, but while out on a
long ride, he fell off his horse and died.

text.jp:
レダと別れ、傷を負った身のまま放浪の旅に
出るが、滞在した町で起こった戦闘に巻き込
まれ死亡する。
text.official_en:
After parting ways with Leda, he began to
wander despite his injuries. He died after
getting caught up in a riot that broke out
in a town where he was staying.

text.jp:
いつものように口説き落とした女性と同衾し
ていたところ、無理心中を図った相手から飲
み物に仕込まれた毒を、鼻の不調のために見
抜くことができず死亡する。
text.official_en:
Sirocco was sharing a bed with a woman
he'd seduced, as was his custom, when due
to a stopped-up nose he was unable to
detect the poison she'd laced their drinks
with. As a result, he perished as part of her
murder-suicide plot.

text.jp:
戦いで負った傷が悪化し、高熱を出して倒れ
る。そのまま意識が戻ることなく、息を引き
取った。
text.official_en:
The wounds she received in battle worsened
until she developed a high fever and
collapsed. She never regained consciousness
and eventually breathed her last.

text.jp:
大剣闘祭の終了後、ダグシオンを去り、傭兵
として各地を転々とする生活に戻り、ある戦
場で戦死する。
text.official_en:
After the end of the Heroic Games, Mikaela
left Dagsion and continued to roam the land
as a mercenary. She fell in battle during a
little-known skirmish.

text.jp:
傷ついた身体を癒すため、レダに対する複雑
な想いに後ろ髪を引かれつつもカーラ神殿に
戻ることにするが、その道の過程で事故に
巻き込まれそのまま消息を絶つ。
text.official_en:
Forced to put her complicated feelings for
Leda aside, Olympia decided to return to
Kalla's temple in order to recover from her
injuries. However, she met with an accident
along the way and was never seen again.
text.real_en:
Forced to put her complicated feelings for
Leda aside, Olympia decided to return to
Cara's temple in order to recover from her
injuries. However, she met with an accident
along the way and was never seen again.

text.jp:
さらなる力を求めて仲間たちのもとを離れ、
孤独な武者修行の旅に出るが、異郷の地で体
調を崩し、そのままこの世を去る。
text.official_en:
Seeking greater strength, he left his
companions behind and set off on a solitary
journey of training. However, he fell ill in
a foreign land and never recovered.

text.jp:
大剣闘祭後もダグシオンに残り、トロイアに
情報を送るコンロンの任務についていたが、
復活したダグザ大帝の命によりダグザの大釜
で処刑される。
text.official_en:
Even after the Heroic Games, she worked
on Kunlun's behalf to relay information to
Troy. However, on the orders of the
resurrected Emperor Dagda, she was put
to death in Dagda's cauldron.

text.jp:
食肉用に捕獲しようとしたクサリクが暴れ、
引きずられてもろとも崖下に転落、そのまま
帰らぬ人となる。
text.official_en:
He tried to capture a kusarik for its meat,
but it was stronger than he anticipated.
It dragged him off a cliff, and he was
never seen again.

text.jp:
ダグシオンで大道芸で生計を立てていたが、
復活したダグザ大帝の命により、他の市民た
ちと一緒にダグザの大釜にて処刑される。
text.official_en:
She eked out a living as a street performer
in Dagsion, but on the orders of the
resurrected Emperor Dagda, she and the
rest of the city's populace were put to death
in Dagda's cauldron.

text.jp:
日常的な大酒が祟り、内臓を悪くして療養生
活を勧められるも酒の量は減ることがなく、
最期は食事の席で血を吐いて倒れ、そのまま
壮絶に息絶える。
text.official_en:
His heavy daily drinking took its toll on his
body. Though he was advised to cut back,
he refused. In the end, he vomited blood
and took his last breath after collapsing at
the dinner table.

text.jp:
酒の席で口論となった相手を殺害してしまい
逃亡者となる。落ち延びた先で追跡してき
た兵士に囲まれて壮絶な死を遂げる。
text.official_en:
After getting drunk and killing someone in
an argument, Yang Jie became a fugitive.
He tried to lie low, but the soldiers in
pursuit eventually surrounded him, and he
died a brutal death.
text.real_en:
After getting drunk and killing someone in
an argument, Yookai became a fugitive.
He tried to lie low, but the soldiers in
pursuit eventually surrounded him, and he
died a brutal death.

text.jp:
大剣闘祭の結末を見届けると自らの居場所を
求め放浪の旅に出るが、山道の崩落で愛馬と
ともに命を落とす。
text.official_en:
After seeing the Heroic Games through to
the end, Io set out in search of a place for
himself. But he and his beloved horse both
lost their lives when a treacherous mountain
road collapsed.

text.jp:
後ろ髪をひかれる思いを抱きつつ母国へ戻っ
たものの、ダグザの地で経験した一連の戦い
の中で負った傷がもとで数年後に王位を退く
こととなった。
text.official_en:
Though reluctant to leave, Peppe returned
to his homeland. But the wounds he
received in his battles in Dagda led him to
abdicate the throne a few years later.

text.jp:
ダグシオンで引き続き剣闘士としての生活を
続けていたが、復活したダグザ大帝の命によ
りダグザの大釜で他の剣闘士たちと一緒に処
刑される。
text.official_en:
Noctula returned to her life as a gladiator
in Dagsion. On the orders of the resurrected
Emperor Dagda, she and the other gladiators
were put to death in Dagda's cauldron.

text.jp:
里帰りの途中、空腹に耐えかねて拾い食いし
た食物にあたり、そのまま帰らぬ人となる。
text.official_en:
On her way home, she was unable to bear
the hunger and died after eating some food
she scavenged.

text.jp:
招待されたとある富豪の家の夕食の際に、上
機嫌で頬張った大きすぎる乾酪をのどに詰ま
らせ、そのまま死亡する。
text.official_en:
During a dinner party at the home of a
wealthy man, Catania was in such good
spirits that she took too large a bite of
cheese, choked, and then died.

text.jp:
ダグシオンを離れ、戦いを求めて放浪を続け
るも、とある戦場にて命を散らす。
text.official_en:
Nydine left Dagsion and continued to roam
in search of combat. She met her end on
an unknown battlefield.

text.jp:
本拠地としていたカエルス郡に戻り、山賊の
暮らしに戻ったが、ある村を襲撃中に偶然そ
の場に居合わせた戦士によって返り討ちにさ
れ、命を落とす。
text.official_en:
Zarcone returned to his home base in
Caelus, where he resumed his life as a
bandit. He met his end while sacking a
village, when a warrior passing through
proved his match.

text.jp:
復活したダグザ大帝の命により他の市民たち
と一緒にダグザの大釜で処刑される際に大立
ち回りを演じ、兵士たち四人を道連れにする
もその場で殺される。彼の遺体はダグザの
大釜に投げ込まれたという。
text.official_en:
Majide was set to be executed in Dagda's
cauldron along with the rest of Dagsion on
orders of the resurrected Emperor Dagda.
His spinning sword technique took four
soldiers with him, but he was killed
nevertheless and thrown into the cauldron.

text.jp:
宗主国軍に合流し、武勲を立てようとするも
戦場に向かう道中に乗っていた戦車が崖下
に転落し、そのまま死亡する。
text.official_en:
He joined the imperial army in an effort to
garner distinguished military service. But on
the way to the battlefield, his chariot veered
off a cliff and he died.

text.jp:
大剣闘祭の終了後に一度故郷に戻りしばしの
休養ののちに傭兵として再起をはかり、戦場
を駆ける暮らしに戻るが、出向いた戦場で命
を散らす。
text.official_en:
Once the Heroic Games ended, Inyoni went
back home. She rested for a while before
making her comeback as a mercenary, but
soon after returning to the battlefield, she
was struck down in combat.

text.jp:
大剣闘祭後はアラゴ王国の領内で傭兵として
活動していたが、依頼人の裏切りにあい仲間
たちとともに戦死する。
text.official_en:
After the Heroic Games, Jasmine worked
as a mercenary within Arago, but she was
betrayed by a client and killed in battle
alongside her comrades.

text.jp:
大剣闘祭の期間中に負った傷の療養中に症状
が急激に悪化、周囲に惜しまれながら息を引
き取る。
text.official_en:
While recovering from wounds sustained at
the Heroic Games, her symptoms took a
turn for the worse. She passed away, with
those around her lamenting her loss.

text.jp:
ダグシオンを離れ、ダナン海を臨む砦跡をア
ジトに再起を狙ったが、現れた亡者に怯える
あまり崖から転落死する。
text.official_en:
He left Dagsion and set up a hideout in the
ruins of a fort overlooking the Danann Sea,
hoping to make his comeback. A ghost
haunting the abandoned fort frightened him
so badly that he fell from a cliff and died.

text.jp:
戦いで負った傷がもとで破傷風にかかり、そ
のまま息絶える。彼の魂が信仰していた魔神
バロールのもとへ辿り着けたかどうかは誰も
知らない。
text.official_en:
Nuzzuo died of the tetanus festering in the
wounds he sustained in battle. No one can
say if his soul reached his deity, the
demon god Balor.

text.jp:
戦闘中に負った深手の治療のため後方に待機
していたが、容態が急変しそのまま帰らぬ人
となる。
text.official_en:
While he waited in the rear lines to be
treated for serious injuries, his condition
took a turn for the worse and he died.

text.jp:
戦闘中に負った深手の治療のため後方に待機
していたが、容態が急変しそのまま帰らぬ人
となる。
text.official_en:
While he waited in the rear lines to be
treated for serious injuries, his condition
took a turn for the worse and he died.

text.jp:
戦いの中で深手を負いながらもかろうじて一
命をとりとめたセテスは軍から離脱すると、
寄港していたフォドラ行きの商船に乗り込み
無事にガルグ＝マクへの帰還を果たす。
text.official_en:
Though gravely wounded in battle, Seteth
barely survived. He left the army and
boarded a merchant ship bound for Fódlan,
where he safely returned to Garreg Mach.

text.jp:
戦いの中で深手を負いながらもかろうじて一
命をとりとめたセテスは軍から離脱すると、
寄港していたフォドラ行きの商船に乗り込み
無事にガルグ＝マクへの帰還を果たす。
text.official_en:
Though gravely wounded in battle, Seteth
barely survived. He left the army and
boarded a merchant ship bound for Fódlan,
where he safely returned to Garreg Mach.
